sections.title: Farron Keep
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 30-45

  1. Extinguish 3 ritual fires
  2. Obtain Sage's Coal in the structure to the left of the first Farron Keep (Andre's quest progression)
  3. Obtain Estus Shard (Andre's quest progression)
  4. Obtain the Sage's Scroll (Orbeck's quest progression)
  5. Obtain the Golden Scroll and give it to Orbeck before beating the Abyss Watchers (Orbeck's quest progression)
  6. Speak with the Old Wolf of Farron for the Watchdogs of Farron covenant (and Legion Etiquette Gesture)
  7. Obtain Dreamchaser's Ashes (Shrine Handmaid's quest progression)
  8. Give Dreamchaser's Ashes to Shrine Handmaid and speak to Sirris of the Sunless Realms at the Firelink Shrine to receive the Darkmoon Loyalty Gestures (Sirris' quest progression)
  9. Give the Pale Tongue to Rosia to be able to summon Yellowfinger Heysel (Doing so will lock you out of Sirris' questline) (Yellowfinger Heysel's quest progression)
  10. Defeat the Abyss Watchers
    1. Summoning Black Hand Gotthard for this fight will reward you with the By My Sword Gesture
    2. Summoning Londor Pale Shade for this fight will reward you with the Duel Bow Gesture

While in the swamp at the Road of Sacrifices, you will need to find 3 ritual fires and extinguish them to open the Farron Keep Perimeter Gate. To the left of the first bonfire, you will encounter a Darkwraith, nearby is a stone tower with a corpse, you can loot the body to obtain the Sage's Coal. Towards the right of the first bonfire, continue the path until you reach a shore that leads up to a cavern where you can obtain the Golden Scroll.

In the center of the swamp, you will find an island with a structure in the middle. There will be several poisonous leeches that surround a corpse that contains Undead Bone Shard. Defeat them and loot the body. Around the swamp, you will find a structure. Take the ladder up and you will find a bonfire as well as the Old Wolf of Farron, interact with the Old Wolf of Farron to join the Watchdogs of Farron Covenant and receive the Legion Etiquette Gesture. Head back out to the other path from the structure and there will be a Crystal Lizard, defeat the lizard, and pick up the Twinkling Titanite, hit the wall by the lizard to open a path to obtain the Dreamchaser's Ashes. There is a pressure plate to step on to activate a lift that takes you to the Stray Demon mini-boss room, defeat it to obtain the Soul of a Stray Demon.

Return to the swamp, make your way to the burning flames, and pick up a Titanite Shard, continue following the flames to encounter the Elder Ghru. After defeating it, 2 Titanite Shards can be obtained by looting a corpse from a nearby tree. Keep exploring the swamp to reach a raised mound where you can pick up a Sunlight Talisman and Estus Soup. Find a small island to find an altar where you can extinguish a ritual flame, continue across the narrow bridge where you will encounter 2 Ghru Grunts and a Ghru Conjurator. After defeating them, continue past them to find the Keep Ruins Bonfire.

Around the swamp, you will find a giant crab that drops the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring when defeated, the Giant of the Undead Settlement will attempt to target you if you have not befriended him, but will fire at the giant crab if you have. After defeating the giant crab, in the corner in the same area, there is a cluster of dead mushrooms and larger mushrooms by a tree. There you can obtain the Sage's Scroll. Follow the wall through the swamp, you will encounter 3 Elder Ghru protecting a Poison Gem, defeat them to obtain the Black Bow of Pharis and Pharis's Hat. Beside the fallen bridge, you can find an Estus Shard with a Rotten Slug nearby, and a body that's wedged between a structure and some rocks contains the Nameless Knight Set.

In the next area, you will find a large ruined area surrounded by trees that contains the Farron Keep Perimeter Bonfire, if you progressed Yuria of Londor's questline, there will be a summon for Londor Pale Shade that will give you the Duel Bow Gestures.

sections.title: Cathedral of the Deep
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 30-45

  1. Find Siegward and his armor
  2. Speak with Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth to join the Rosaria's Finger Covenant

From the first bonfire, take the staircase up through the archway into the woods to encounter some undead dogs and hallows that are attempting to attack you. After clearing the area, head to the right side of the area and pick up the Large Soul of an Unknown Traveler that sits on a ledge.

Head into the cathedral through the double doors, you will find a bonfire in front of an altar. (You can start the Ashes of Arandiel DLC by interacting with either Slave Knight Gael [the guy with the red hood] or a painting that's near the altar.) You will find Siegward in the well, he will appear when you have opened the double doors that lead to the graveyard from the cathedral. Exit the cathedral and make your way to the right side, take out the hollows that surround a corpse to loot the Estus Shard. Continue down this path until you drop down to a path that leads to a cross stone bridge, several zombie hollows will be found here. Take them out to freely explore the area, there will also be corpses to loot. You will be able to find 1 Young White Branch, 2 Large Soul of an Unknown Travelers, 2 Repair Powder, and 1 Undead Bone Shard.

Make your way to the chapel area where you will encounter a Cathedral Knight and several cleric hollows, make your way to the lift on the other side of the set of stairs. Open the shortcut and you will find Siegward after reloading the area, speak with him and give him his armor.

Continue exploring until you reach the lift past the double doors, take it up to encounter an enemy that wields a crossbow. Take the narrow ledge outside around the corner to a ladder, take the ladder up and take out the enemy and obtain the Deep Ring at the end of a wood plank ramp. Keep exploring to find a broken portion of a gate, and open the double doors to a room with a bonfire. In this room, you will find the Armor of Thorns Set on a body (only if you have been invaded by Longfinger Kirk), Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth can also be found in this room. Speak to her about joining Rosaria's Finger's Covenant. Outside Rosaria's Bedchamber, you can find Unbreakable Patches there if you have progressed through his questline correctly.

sections.title: Catacombs of Carthus
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 40-50

  1. Obtain the Carthus Pyromancy Tome
  2. Speak with Anri of Astora twice
  3. Obtain the Grave Warden's Ashes
  4. Defeat the Demon
  5. Gain access to the Smouldering Lake

Once you enter the catacombs, explore the area until you reach an archway after a set of small platforms. Go through to get ambushed by a skeleton, take it out, and pick up the Carthus Pyromancy Tome from a grave. Go through the doorway and hit the wall to reveal an illusory wall, make your way through to the next area to the room with a few skeletons and some with red eyes. After defeating them, take the doorway to the left of the stairs into a hallway going right to meet Anri of Astora. Speak with her and she will ask you about Horace the Hushed. Return to the room with the red-eyed skeletons and take the stairs down to the very bottom. A boulder made up of bodies will come down and upon breaking, it will drop an Undead Bone Shard. Continue exploring this area through a set of doorways and hallways, eventually, you will find a bonfire.

In the lower area of the catacombs, make your way down the path of the boulder and take a left, and continue along the path. There will be a group of Skeleton Wheels, take them out, and continue to the left to find a body that contains the Carthus Bloodring. Make your way back up the stairs until you reach doorway to the left, pick up the Ember on a corpse near the closed gate. Continue back up the stairs, down the hall and to the left to find a corpse that contains the Grave Warden's Ashes.

After exploring the catacombs, make your way to the chamber. Continue through the chamber, before the bridge, head to the path on the right up a stone hill to find Anri of Astora, and speak with her a second time. Hope down the ledge to get to the other side of the bridge, cut the rope to drop the bridge, which drops the skeletons as well. Make your way down to fight the Demon who is guarding the entrance to Smouldering Lake, once defeated, you will gain access to the bonfire and Smouldering Lake.

sections.title: Smouldering Lake (Optional)
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 40-55

  1. Obtain Undead Bone Shards
  2. Obtain Speckled Stoneplate Ring
  3. Light the Old King's Antechamber Bonfire
  4. Obtain the Izalith Pyromancy Tome
  5. Obtain the Quelana Pyromancy Tome
  6. Defeat Horace the Hushed

When you reach Smouldering Lake, a ballista will target you as you explore the swamp until you disable it. Follow the path on the left to encounter a Carthus Sandworm, you can use the ballista to take out the worm and it will drop a Lightning Stake and an Undead Bone Shard. Towards the right, there is a hill where you can find a doorway to a staircase that leads to the Demon Ruins Bonfire. Head back up to a man-made stone wall so that the ballista can shoot at it, you will be able to obtain the Speckled Stoneplate Ring.

From the Demon Ruins Bonfire, continue down the stairs to the next area. Take out the enemies in this area and continue exploring. Through the right side of the hallway, you will encounter a few enemies you've encountered in Farron Keep. Take out the enemies and continue the path until you reach a hole in the ground, across is a body that contains the Estus Shard. If you manage to jump across, pick up the Estus Shard and continue down the hallway, take the path on the right and attack the illusory wall at the end of the hallway. Enter the path to find the Old King's Antechamber Bonfire.

Exit the bonfire room through the door opposite the illusory wall, and continue straight down the path into a room where you will encounter a Ghru. Inside the room, there is a corpse that you can loot to obtain the Izalith Pyromancy Tome. Backtrack to the bonfire room and exit through the doorway that leads to the staircase going down, make your way down and follow the hallway to the end and hit the wall to reveal an illusory wall. Enter the room, defeat the Black Knight and loot the Black Knight Sword. Into the next room with several enemies, defeat them and obtain the Undead Bone Shard. Enter the doorway in the corner and follow the hallway to find a room with small rats, hit the wall to reveal an illusory wall, head in and on the left to obtain the Quelana Pyromancy Tome.

On a stone wall, take the few ladders up, head into the room, and follow the path on the left to find a room with several skeletons, defeat the skeletons, and make your way to disable the ballista. Make your way down the path behind the ballista and drop down until you reach the water. Head left and continue down that path into an open area where you find Horace the Hushed, confront him and you will have to kill him and loot the Llewellyn Shield. After this, you can return to Anri and tell her what happened.

Back at the main lake, head to the fog at the stairs past the worm. You may summon the Great Swamp Cuculus to be able to obtain the Spotted Whip or the Cornyx Armor set. Enter the fog to take on the Old Demon King, defeat him and you can light the bonfire.

sections.title: Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 55-65

  1. Summon Sirris of the Sunless Realms to defeat Creighton the Wanderer
  2. Speak with Anri of Astora
  3. Obtain Estus Soup (Siegward's quest progression)
  4. Defeat Pontiff Sulyvahn
  5. Speak to Archdeacon McDonnell to join the Aldrich Faithful covenant
  6. Complete Anri of Astora's questline

Light the bonfire to your left when you enter this area and continue towards the left, make your way to the bridge. Defeat the Sulyvahn's Beast that spawns behind you on the bridge and you will be able to obtain Pontiff's Right Eye. You will find some of Sirris of the Sunless Realms summons, when you use one of them, you can summon her while fighting Creighton the Wanderer. Once defeated, speak with her in Firelink Shrine to be rewarded with the Silvercat Ring and the Blessed Mail Breaker. To cross the bridge, you will need to have obtained the Small Doll by defeating the Deacons of the Deep in the Cathedral of the Deep. When you get across, there will be a bonfire to the right for you to light. Head up the stairs on the right and continue down the path until you reach a short staircase where you find a Crystal Lizard. Hit the railing of the staircase to reveal a hidden staircase, make your way down the stairs and continue up head to find an Evangelist, defeat it to obtain Dorhy's Gnawing. Nearby is a gate to unlock the shortcut back to the first bonfire.

Continue up the path and you will be able to obtain a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier from a corpse and the Church of Yorshka bonfire past it. Go towards the left first and continue this path to find an altar, hit the wall behind the altar to reveal an illusory wall where you can obtain the Magic Clutch Ring. Return to the bonfire and speak with Anri of Astora to progress her questline and obtain the Quiet Resolve Gesture. In the corner, there is an NPC that is camouflaged as a statue and want to assassinate Anri. Killing this NPC will save Anri and reward you with Chameleon but ending Yuria of Londor's questline. Past the doorway, take the stairs down until you reach the water to the next area.

On this body of water, towards the underpass is a bonfire and the entrance to Irithyll Dungeon and towards the Profaned Capital. For now, continue this area before going into the dungeon. Head into the sewer to encounter a few Sewer Centipedes, make your way through the sewers to find a staircase where you can obtain the Excrement-covered Ashes. Take the stairs into a room to obtain Estus Soup in a cauldron, and keep the soup for Siegward of Catarina's questline, he can be found in the same room if you have been progressing through his questline. Take the stairs up and enter the room to the nook. Take the stairs ahead to loot the Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier by the base of a tree. A Londor Pale Shade could invade you only if you are on bad terms with Yuria, and defeat them to obtain Manikin Claws.

Make your way to the main courtyard, to the fog gate. You can summon Black Hand Gotthard, Londor Pale Shade, or Anri of Astora depending on your progress on her questline. Enter the arena for your fight against Pontiff Sulyvahn, once defeated there will be a bonfire in this arena. Make your way to a set of stairs that leads to a platform with a pressure plate to lower the pillar as a shortcut to the Pontiff Sulyvahn bonfire.

Make your way to the building up the stairs and hit the wall on the left to reveal an illusory wall to a ladder, take the ladder down to a flooded chamber with Sulyvahn's Beasts, defeat them to obtain the Ring of Favor. In the same room, you will find Archdeacon McDonnell, the covenant leader of the Aldrich Faithful, along with the bonfire in the center.

From the entrance of the building, take the stairs up and drop down onto a ledge in this area. On the next landing, head up the narrow roof and continue past the next set of roofs and look for a structure. Head right and you will find a doorway to a tower. Head in this tower and take the ladder down, to access the shortcut. Exit the tower and return to the landing to find a doorway that leads to a round room, look for the statue and attack it to reveal an illusory wall to a set of stairs. Take the set of stairs down to a chamber where you can loot the Brass Set off of a corpse. Head into the Darkroom Tomb and look for Anri of Astora to complete their questline, and in the same room is a chest that contains the Reversal Ring.

Back at the round room, there is a lever that brings a rotating platform to you. Step onto the platform and take the stairs up to the next lever to rotate the platform to the top. Once at the top, step onto the bridge and enter Anor Londo, light the bonfire in this area. From the rotating platform, make your way down the spiral steps to the dead end platform. Step off the platform to land on an invisible bridge, drop down to the right onto a tower. There is a bonfire here and follow the left path to meet Company Captain Yorshka the leader of the Blades of the Darkmoon.

sections.title: Irithyll Dungeon
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 55-65

  1. Obtain Jailbreaker's Key
  2. Obtain Jailer's Key Ring
  3. Meet Karla

Head into the doorway and make the right turn, at the end of the path is a locked door that can be opened with the Jailbreaker's Key which can be found in a cell later on. Make your way down the hall and take a left turn to a room with a locked cell that can be opened with the Jailer's Key Ring that can be opened by following Siegward's questline, in the locked cell contains the Prisoner Chief's Ashes. Take the stairs and explore the area until you reach a barred door. Once you open the barred door, make your way down the hall to open a cell door to find the Jailbreaker's Key on a corpse. Once you retrieve it, you can return to the locked door near the bonfire to use the key.

Continue exploring until you reach the sewer area, at the end of the path there will be 2 chests, the right one contains the Old Cell Key and the left one is a mimic that drops Dark Clutch Ring. Continue through the sewers until you pass the room infested with jailers that leads to a set of stairs. When you exit, there is a Dragon Torso Stone on the left and in the area. You will need to use the Path of the Dragon Gesture when you obtain it by defeating Oceiros, the Consumed King, doing so will grant you access to Archdragon Peak. For now, continue through the doorway onto a pressure plate to activate the lift. Take the lift up and head forward to the corpse to obtain Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier. The door on the left is the shortcut back to the dungeon.

Head into the dungeon and explore the area until you reach a set of stairs, take the stairs up to find a locked door at the end of the hall that Karla is in. You will need to use the Jailer's Key Ring to unlock the door. Once you speak to her, you will have access to learn Pyromancies, Sorceries, and Dark Miracles.

sections.title: Profaned Capital
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 55-65

  1. Free Siegward of Catarina
  2. Free Karla

From the bonfire, take the narrow stone bridge that leads you to the Profaned Capital and towards the Lords of Cinder. Cross the bridge then take the ladder down and the next ladder up. Continue exploring this area to pick up loot until you find yourself on a rooftop with a few windows on the other side. Head in and use the Old Cell Key, in this room you can obtain the Covetous Gold Serpent Ring and also find Siegward of Catarina in a cell. Head down and obtain the Jailer's Key Ring. Now that you have the Jailer's Key Ring, return to Karla and unlock the door, speak to her and you will be able to free her. Complete this area by defeating the boss Yhorm the Giant past the fog gates, once defeated you will be reward with the Cinders of a Lord, and Soul of Yhorm the Giant.

sections.title: Anor Londo
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 55-65

  1. Continue Anri of Astora's questline
  2. Defeat Aldrich, Devourer of Gods

From the bonfire at the entrance of Anor Londo, enter the castle to progress Anri's questline. Interact with the purple sign on the ground that will make you summonable as a phantom to assist her in defeating Aldrich, Devourer of Gods. You will no gain any rewards from this fight as this fight does not take place in your world. So you will have to face him in your world, and when you defeat him, you will obtain the Soul of Aldrich and Cinders of a Lord.

sections.title: High Wall of Lothric
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 55-65

  1. Speak with Emma
  2. Defeat Dancer of the Boreal Valley

You will need to kill three of the Lords of Cinders to be transported to Emma's room so she can give you the Basin of Vows before dying. Light the bonfire and place the Basin of Vows at the altar to trigger a cutscene of a ladder, and also the Dancer of the Boreal Valley boss fight. Defeat the boss and take the ladder up to the next area, Lothric Castle.

sections.title: Lothric Castle
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 75-90

  1. Defeat the Boreal Outrider Knight
  2. Pray at the altar to receive the Praise the Sun Gesture for the Warrior of Sunlight Covenant
  3. Obtain the Braille Divine Tome of Lothric
  4. Defeat Dragonslayer Armour

Take the stairs on the right then head into the room to light the bonfire. Make your way into the next room to find a chest that contains the Prayer Set. Take the stairs on the left and up the tower and take a left to light the Dragon Barracks Bonfire.

Towards the stone bridge are two Lothric Wyverns that will spew out fire, killing one of them will cause both of them to die. Near the end of the bridge, you can drop down to pick up an Undead Bone Shard from a corpse. Back onto the stone bridge, explore the area and make your way to a set of stairs. Take the stairs and follow the path on the right to encounter a Boreal Outrider Knight, there's a chance for this enemy to drop the Irithyll Rapier.

Exit the church portion and take the lift up and take the ladder up on the left and explore the rooftops and head into a building and take the ladder down. Cross the bridge and follow the path to pray at the altar to learn the Praise the Sun Gesture and join the Warrior of Sunlight Covenant. Exit through the double doors and make your way around the fallen wyvern to attack it while taking cover inside a dead wyvern. In this room you can find a mimic with the Sunlight Straight Sword, pick up the Braille Divine Tome of Lothric that sits on top of the stairs.

Pick up Braille Divine Tome of Lothric to advance Irina's questline, which could lead to 2 endings.

  • Ending 1: Giving her the Braille Divine Tome of Carim and Braille Divine Tome of Lothric, or all 4 Tomes and not purchasing any of Dark Miracles. Irina will be a Fire Keeper. She will move to the bottom of the tower, by the left of the Firelink Shrine. If you give her the Londor and Deep Tome instead of giving them to Karla, she will leave them on the floor beside her, you will be able to give them Karla.
  • Ending 2: Giving her the Braille Divine Tome of Carim and Braille Divine Tome of Lothric, and purchasing Deep Protection, Gnaw, Dark Blade, Vow of Silence, or Dead Again. She can later be found near the Index Gundyr with Eygon. Eygon will think you are hostile and will try to kill you. Upon defeating him, Irina will return to Firelink Shrine. Buying all the Dark Miracles will cause her to be fully corrupted and no longer act as a merchant for you. Equip Morne's Gauntlets and interact with her, she will ask you to kill her.

Walk through the fog to fight Dragonslayer Armour, you can choose to summon Eygon of Carim for this fight if you wish. Defeating him will reward you with the Soul of Dragonslayer Armour. Across this bridge is a bonfire you can light, take the stairs up into the next room and you will find another bonfire to the entrance of the Grand Archives.

sections.title: Consumed King's Garden (Optional)
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 65-75

  1. Defeat Oceiros, the Consumed King
  2. Obtain Path of the Dragon Gesture
  3. Reach Untended Greaves through the illusory wall behind the chest

In the toxic swamp, you will find a doorway, make your way up the stairs, and take the lift up to the courtyard. Keep making your way up and open the door that is the shortcut to Lothric Castle. Return to the lift and head down, midway down roll out of the lift and onto a ledge to excite the tower. Take the stairs down to find a corpse containing the Dragonscale Ring. Continue the path and defeat the two Iron Knights, one of them will drop the Magic Stoneplate Ring.

Take the stairs up into a fog gate that leads you to the Oceiros, the Consumed King boss arena. Light the bonfire after defeating him, head through the double doors, and continue this path. In the next room, there is a corpse that contains the Path of the Dragon Gesture, this gesture grants you access to Archdragon Peak. Defeating the Drakeblood Knight in Archdragon Peak will drop the Drakeblood Set where you've picked up the gesture. Make your way to the upper section with a chest that contains a Titanite Scale, hit the wall behind the chest to reveal an illusory wall, go through it, light the bonfire, and discover the Untended Graves.

sections.title: Untended Graves (Optional)
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 70-85

  1. Obtain the Ashen Estus Ring
  2. Defeat Champion Gundyr
  3. Obtain the Coiled Sword Fragment

From the bonfire, make your way down the path, defeat the group of Corvians, and pick up the Ashen Estus Ring. Continue on the left and continue making your way until you reach the arena of Champion Gundyr, defeat him to obtain the Soul of Champion Gundyr. In the arena you can obtain the Black Knight Glaive on a corpse by the broken wall, light the bonfire, exit through the double doors, and make your way to the dark Firelink Shrine to pick up the Coiled Sword Fragment.

Continue on the left and continue making your way until you reach the arena of Champion Gundyr , defeat him to obtain the Soul of Champion Gundyr . In the arena you can obtain the Black Knight Glaive on a corpse by the broken wall, light the bonfire, exit through the double doors, and make your way to the dark Firelink Shrine to pick up the Coiled Sword Fragment .

sections.title: Grand Archives
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 65-80

  1. Defeat the Crystal Sage for the Crystal Scroll (Orbeck's quest progression)
  2. Interact with the wax pool by the altar
  3. Defeat the Boreal Outrider Knight
  4. Obtain Titanite Slab
  5. Defeat the 3 hostile NPCs
  6. Defeat Lothric, Younger Prince

From the bonfire, open the double doors using the Grand Archives Key, obtainable by defeating 3 Lords of Cinder. Defeat the Crystal Sage in this room and it will drop the Crystal Scroll. Take the stairs on the left side of the room until you reach the library, there is an altar there in the room. Defeat the wax-covered priests and interact with the wax pool to cover your character in wax to avoid being cursed by enemies. Head into the next room on the right, and continue along the bookcases until after you've past the third one. There is a lever that opens to a secret room on the left where you can obtain the Witch's Locks in a chest, and Power Within on a corpse. Take the stairs up into the next room and take the ladder down. Look for a balcony and take the ladder up, head into the next room to encounter the Crystal Sage if you have not killed him yet in your first encounter in the room after the bonfire. At the end of the path on the right, take the stairs on the right and take the staircase on the opposite side. Hit the wall to your right to reveal an illusory wall, a Boreal Outrider Knight will be in the next room, defeat it to obtain the Outrider Knight Set. Exit the room and drop to the lower level and take the walkway out to reach a set of stairs. Take the stairs up and take the lift up, exit the lift and pull the lever to open the shortcut to the main entrance.

Take the lift back up and turn to the left to find a lever to reveal a secret room where you can find the Scholar Ring on a corpse by a wax pool. Make your way down the stairs and to the left is another lever to pull, a bookcase will be lowered which will reveal a chest and another wax pool. Head to the wax pool but turn away from it to face a railing, head to the railings and on the right there's a chest that contains a Titanite Slab. Return to the central bridge and exit through the doorway located up the stairs, drop down to the left to reach the rooftops. Continue on this path until you drop down to enter a building that is guarded by a wax priest.

Make your way into the building and kick down the ladder, go down and make a right to a courtyard with 3 NPCs on top of the stairs. Defeat them to obtain the Golden Wing Crest Shield, Sage's Crystal Staff, and the Onikiri and Ubadachi. You can pick up the Large Soul of a Crestfallen Knight. Continue up the stairs to a building, to the right is a lift, activating it opens the shortcut back to the Grand Archives bonfire. Take the lift up and take the path on the right and up the stairs and through the archway on the right to pick up an Estus Shard. Make your way back to the roof and into the building, walk onto a beam to pick up the Blessed Gem, drop down to the next beam and take the ladder down.

From the shortcut lift, head out and take the main path until you reach a doorway on the right to enter a building to another lift, activating it reveals a shortcut to Lothric Castle. Open the double doors to the Lothric, Younger Prince boss arena, defeat him to obtain Cinders of a Lord and Soul of the Twin Princes. Light the bonfire in this area, return to Firelink Shrine, and place the Cinders on the throne to initiate the battle at theKiln of the First Flame

sections.title: Archdragon Peak (Optional)
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 95-120

  1. Defeat Ancient Wyvern
  2. Obtain Dragon Head Stone (Hawkwood's quest progression)
  3. Use Path of the Dragon Gesture at the altar to obtain Twinkling Dragon Torso Stone (Hawkwood's quest progression)
  4. Obtain Dragon Chaser's Ashes (Shrine Handmaid's quest progression)
  5. Defeat Nameless King

Make your way down the path after the cutscene to find the Archdragon Peak bonfire, head up the stairs and enter the building on the left. Head down the hall, to the right you can pick up the Lightning Clutch Ring. Make your way to the large gate and pull the lever to enter the Ancient Wyvern boss arena, defeating the Ancient Wyvern will reward you with the Dragon Head Stone and transport you back to the Dragon Mausoleum bonfire.

Go through the doorway to encounter either a Drakeblood Knight or Havel the Rock summoned by a Serpent-man Sorcerer, you will obtain the Drakeblood Greatsword upon defeating them. Exit the central doorway up to the building to the right and continue on this path to find a lift to activate that takes you back to the beginning of the area. Go down the stairs to find an altar in front of a dragon statue, you will need to perform the Path of the Dragon Gesture statue to receive the Calamity Ring. Take the stairs up to a large gated door, you will obtain the Dragonslayer Spear when you examine the door.

Exit the building and take the stairs to the left, at the top of the stairs, a wyvern will linger around the area. It will leave if you leave this area immediately and return if you return and will start to attack you. Defeat it and take the stairs up and enter the building, take the stairs down and through the doorway on the right to the next room. Exit the room after defeating the enemies here and head to the left to find a lever with a large bell, ignore the lever for now and continue the path to find the Great Belfry bonfire.

Continue through the doorway on the right of the bonfire to the crumbling ruins. Take the stairs down and take the path on the left, look for a ladder. Take the ladder down to find a Havel NPC standing in front of a fallen wyvern, and defeat him to obtain the Dragon Tooth and Havel's Greatshield. Make your way back to the main central courtyard of the ruins, head left from the archway to find a corpse that contains the Dragon Chaser's Ashes that can be used at the Shrine Handmaid in Firelink Shrine. Enter the archway and take the long stairs up, use the Path of the Dragon Gesture at the altar to receive the Twinkling Dragon Torso Stone.

Back in the room with the lever with the bell, interact with it to see a cutscene. After the cutscene, step into the fog path to face the Nameless King. Defeat him to obtain the Soul of the Nameless King. Another cutscene will play and you will be teleported back to a bonfire.

sections.title: Kiln of the First Flame
sections.content_html:
Recommended Levels: 95-120

  1. Defeat Soul of Cinder
  • Ending 1: Interact with the First Flame for the "To Link the First Flame" ending
  • Ending 2: Obtain the Eyes of a Fire Keeper for the "The End of Fire" ending
  • Ending 3: Attack the Fire Keeper for an alternate cutscene for the "The End of Fire" ending
  • Ending 4: Have 8 Dark Sigils, complete Yoel & Yuri's quest, marry Anri for the "Usurpation of Fire" ending

Requirements:

You will need to have defeated the 4 Lords of Cinder and place their ashes on their empty thrones and speak to the Fire Keeper. Activate the bonfire in this area to watch a cutscene and will teleport you to the bonfire at the Kiln of the First Flame which resembles a darker version of the Firelink Shrine. Head outside to the path to activate the bonfire to proceed to the First Flame, light the bonfire and head to the path to encounter the Soul of Cinder, defeat him to obtain the Soul of the Lords.

After defeating boss, you will then have the choice of the following endings:

  • Use the bonfire resulting in the 'To Link the Fire' ending and the unlocking of said achievement.
  • If you have obtained the Eyes of a Fire Keeper from the Untended Graves area and have given it to the Fire Keeper you can use a summon sign next to the bonfire to trigger the 'The End of Fire' ending and the unlocking of said achievement. During this scene you have a short window where you can attack the Firekeeper after the cutscene for what is effectively a 4th ending option. (WARNING: If you opt for the 4th option, you WILL NOT get the achievement for The End of Fire)
  • If an optional quest line is completed involving Yuria and Anri to become Prince of Londor, you can usurp the flame by wrestling the flame from its mantle triggering the 'Usurpation of Fire' ending and the unlocking of said achievement. To progress this option, you must take all 5 levels from Yoel, and not cure the Dark Sigil at any point.

sections.content_text: Recommended Levels: 95-120 Defeat Soul of Cinder Ending 1: Interact with the First Flame for the "To Link the First Flame" ending Ending 2: Obtain the Eyes of a Fire Keeper for the "The End of Fire" ending Ending 3: Attack the Fire Keeper for an alternate cutscene for the "The End of Fire" ending Ending 4: Have 8 Dark Sigils , complete Yoel & Yuri's quest, marry Anri for the "Usurpation of Fire" ending Requirements : You will need to have defeated the 4 Lords of Cinder and place their ashes on their empty thrones and speak to the Fire Keeper. Activate the bonfire in this area to watch a cutscene and will teleport you to the bonfire at the Kiln of the First Flame which resembles a darker version of the Firelink Shrine . Head outside to the path to activate the bonfire to proceed to the First Flame , light the bonfire and head to the path to encounter the Soul of Cinder , defeat him to obtain the Soul of the Lords . After defeating boss, you will then have the choice of the following endings : Use the bonfire resulting in the 'To Link the Fire' ending and the unlocking of said achievement. If you have obtained the Eyes of a Fire Keeper from the Untended Graves area and have given it to the Fire Keeper you can use a summon sign next to the bonfire to trigger the 'The End of Fire' ending and the unlocking of said achievement. During this scene you have a short window where you can attack the Firekeeper after the cutscene for what is effectively a 4th ending option. (WARNING: If you opt for the 4th option, you WILL NOT get the achievement for The End of Fire) If an optional quest line is completed involving Yuria and Anri to become Prince of Londor, you can usurp the flame by wrestling the flame from its mantle triggering the 'Usurpation of Fire' ending and the unlocking of said achievement. To progress this option, you must take all 5 levels from Yoel , and not cure the Dark Sigil at any point. Subcontent:Game Progress Route 2 Boss Guide Videos

sections.title: Game Progress Route Notes, Trivia, Lore and Tips in Dark Souls 3
sections.content_html:
• Secret Shortcut: While the Game Progress Route path directs players toward the Undead Settlement after defeating Vordt, there is a potential for a shortcut. By attacking and killing Emma, High Priestess of Lothric Castle in the cathedral opposite Vordt's arena, you force the spawn of the Dancer of the Boreal Valley boss fight. Defeating the Dancer early grants immediate access to Lothric Castle. While highly difficult for low-level characters, completing this sequence break allows players to bypass the early-game upgrade cap, harvest Titanite Chunks, and upgrade a weapon to +9 before facing the Abyss Watchers.
  • The Abyss Watchers as a "Point of No Return": When routing your Game Progress Route through Farron Keep, you must treat the Abyss Watchers boss fog as a hard "Point of No Return" for early-game NPC quests. The moment this boss is defeated, this updates the world state, causing several severe consequences: Yoel of Londor will immediately die , permanently locking you out of the Usurpation of Fire ending. Additionally, if you have recruited Orbeck of Vinheim but failed to give him at least one Magic Scroll, he will permanently leave Firelink Shrine, severely crippling Intelligence-based playthroughs. Ensure all early Firelink NPC interactions are finalized before clearing Farron Keep.
  • Yoel and the Dark Sigils: If you are pursuing the "Usurpation of Fire" ending, your Game Progress Route must account for deliberate mechanical deaths. You gain Hollowing equal to your current Dark Sigils every time you die. To unlock all five levels before the Abyss Watchers cutoff, you must actively pause your Game Progress Route and die repeatedly to reach 15 Hollowing. Furthermore, you must never use the Fire Keeper to "Heal the Dark Sigil," as this permanently removes you from the Lord of Hollows questline route.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content_html:
Overview


“

Take on the deadliest planet in the known galaxy as a team of dwarven mercenary miners in our upcoming procedurally generated co-op sci-fi shooter - Deep Rock Galactic!

In the far future, space mining is big business.

The interplanetary mining corporation DEEP ROCK GALACTIC specializes in securing the most dangerous dig sites in the galaxy. When they need a team for the toughest missions, they call in the Dwarves - mercenary miners, legendary for their ability to survive underground, and infamous for their brutality in combat.

Join a team of up to 4 players to fight, dig and explore your way through enormous cave systems, uncover the greatest riches, and make it out alive.

— from the official site

sections.title: Key Features
sections.content_html:
• 1-4 PLAYER CO-OP
    • Work together as a team to dig, explore, and fight your way through a massive cave system filled with hordes of deadly enemies and valuable resources. You will need to rely on your teammates if you want to survive the most hostile cave systems in the galaxy!
  • 4 UNIQUE CLASSES
    • Pick the right class for the job. Mow through enemies as the Gunner, scout ahead and light up the caves as the Scout, chew through solid rock as the Driller, or support the team with defensive structures and turrets as the Engineer.
  • FULLY DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENTS
    • Destroy everything around you to reach your goal. There is no set path so you can complete your mission your way. Drill straight down to your objective or build an intricate network of paths to explore your surroundings -- the choice is yours. But proceed with caution, you don’t want to stumble into an alien swarm unprepared!
  • PROCEDURALLY GENERATED CAVE NETWORK
    • Explore a network of procedurally generated cave systems filled with enemies to fight and riches to collect. There’s always something new to discover and no two playthroughs are alike.
  • HIGH-TECH GADGETS AND WEAPONS
    • Dwarves know what they need to bring to get the job done. This means the most powerful weapons and the most advanced gadgets around - flamethrowers, gatling guns, portable platform launchers, and much, much more.
  • LIGHT YOUR PATH
    • The underground caves are dark and full of terrors. You will need to bring your own lights if you want to illuminate these pitch-black caverns.

sections.title: Description
sections.content_html:
Deep Rock Galactic is a procedurally generated first person co-op shooter for up to 4 players, developed in Unreal Engine 4 by Ghost Ship Games, It was released into early access on Steam on the 28th February 2018, and launched to version 1.0 on the 13th of May 2020.

Players take on the role of a team of veteran dwarven space miners, venturing into the deepest, most dangerous cave systems of the most hostile planet ever discovered, to gather ores for their corporate overlords, while expanding their roster of class-based skills and unlocking new gear and weapons.

sections.title: Lore
sections.content_html:
A letter from Management

Congratulations, [NEW DWARVEN EMPLOYEE]! By signing up with DEEP ROCK GALACTIC, you have just taken your first step towards becoming an essential gear in the machine of the MOST TENACIOUS space mining corporation in the known galaxy!

At DEEP ROCK GALACTIC, we pride ourselves on having established practical dominance of some the most lucrative systems in the OUTER RIM.
While our foolish and cowardly competitors generally regard these as too volatile or high-risk, DEEP ROCK GALACTIC calls them home.

At this time, we have a total of 89 ORBITAL SPACE RIGS in operation throughout MORE THAN A DOZEN Outer Rim systems, with 16 MORE currently under construction.

However, a NEW MANDATE is upon us! While our digs number in the dozens already, we are currently engaged in our most daring and heavily orchestrated mining operation to date: The COMPLETE SUBJUGATION of the planet HOXXES IV.

HOXXES IV constitutes, to the best of our knowledge, the SINGLE MOST LUCRATIVE mining location in the galaxy, containing the RICHEST AND MOST DENSE concentrations of valuable minerals we have ever encountered.
However, it also just happens to be the SINGLE MOST HOSTILE place we have ever mapped. Several competitors before us have tried to tame Hoxxes IV, WITHOUT LUCK.

DEEP ROCK GALACTIC will succeed. DEEP ROCK GALACTIC is not in the business of failing.

MANAGEMENT BIDS YOU WELCOME, NEW MINER. WELCOME ABOARD.

Working at Deep Rock Galactic

TEAMWORK IS KEY
At DEEP ROCK GALACTIC we value TEAMWORK above all else! The sheer hostility of Hoxxes IV means anyone caught away from their team will be in for a world of hurt.
As a responsible INTERPLANETARY MINING CONGLOMERATE, we depend on our employees to take care of each other. In other words - we won’t be there holding your hand.

As the saying goes: "Dig together - or dig your own grave".

NEXT-LEVEL SPACE MINING
At DEEP ROCK GALACTIC we specialise in SPACE MINING at the most dangerous dig sites in the galaxy, and we call upon those with a natural predisposition towards hard, honest work!

We believe in LEAN MINING, and we expect the same of you. Why send in a massive and costly mining operation when a CRACK SQUAD of highly-skilled mining operatives will do?

MYSTERIOUS CAVES
At DEEP ROCK GALACTIC we say that any cave can be conquered, so long as our drills remain fueled and lubricated!

While no two caves will ever be the same, our dedicated RESEARCH DEPARTMENT is constantly at work peeling apart the tectonic layers of the planet, locating the most lucrative caves and categorizing them accordingly.

MOVE UP THE COMPANY LADDER
At DEEP ROCK GALACTIC we are big on PROMOTIONS! So big, in fact, that we tally up EVERYTHING you do and calculate your Rank based on that!

Upon first joining us, your Rank will be 0 (lovingly referred to as Greenbeards among the employees). You will not remain a Greenbeard for long, however - while your objectives will carry you ever further down, your standing within the company will only go up!*

*Provided, of course, you are fortunate and skilled enough to survive.

sections.content_html:
Deep Rock Galactic Wiki is focused on creating the definitive guide to Deep Rock Galactic. But while we make an effort to be complete, which may include game bugs and fixes for them, we are not an official game support channel.

For official game support, the developers or members of the community can be contacted on the official Deep Rock Galactic Discord server if you need support.

Bugs and issues can be reported on the official BetaHub platform.

sections.title: Side Missions
sections.content_html:
Mystery of the Missing T-Shirt

Hiroko Sagisaka texts Yuki, saying that T-Shirts are going missing and to come to Kosuke Misono's office as it may be an anomaly. She says it may be a ghost stealing them, since a human would've been caught by now, and so they should look into it. The owner of the shop says the shirts fly away on their own, and that it had actually happened just before they arrived. They follow a customer into an alley, who says he saw a monster go into the sewers with the T-Shirt. Inside, they find a ZubaEagermon wondering how it can make the stolen T-Shirts "scream Twentiest". Hiroko and Yuki confront him, and he asks them if they're Twentiest. They have no idea what tha means, and their answer on how to make the shirt Twentiest angers him. As such, Yuki and Aegiomon fight him. They defeat him and take all the stolen T-Shirts back, though Hiroko says they now have to figure out what Twentiest is. The shopkeeper thanks them for solving it, and says he'll give them discounts if they ever buy from him.

The Targeted Cosplayer

Hiroko Sagisaka texts Yuki, saying a cosplayer had gone missing in Shinjuku Park. Yuki, Hiroko, Aegiomon, and Minervamon go to the park, where Hiroko had agreed to meet with the cosplayer's friend. She explains how the friend had gone missing whilst cosplaying in the park, and Hiroko decides to recreate the moment by forcing Yuki to cosplay as one of the Chosen Children from Digimon Adventure (Kanan as Kari Kamiya, Dan as Taichi "Tai" Kamiya). When Yuki starts walking around in the outfit, a portal opens and sucks them both in. They end up in the same place as the cosplayer, who tells them to get away before the monster returns. Tuskmon shows up and is happy at having finally caught a Tamer, and attacks them so they can't run away — saying their master would be mad if it lost the Tamer. After they kill Tuskmon, Hiroko asks if the cosplayer knows the master, though she says no as she only saw Tuskmon. As they wonder how they can return, they're sucked into another portal that takes them back. The cosplayer's friend thanks them for saving her, whilst Hiroko continues to wonder who Tuskmon's master was.

Infinite Imagination

Hiroko Sagisaka says she got a tip from a social media fan about an anomaly. The fan had created their own character, and that their character's data had disappeared one day. Shortly afterwards, they got messages telling them to go to a back alley in Akihabara. This scared them, hence Hiroko. They, Aegiomon, and Minervamon search around Akihabara, and eventually find a bunch of giant plastic blocks. When they try to investigate it, Shota Kuroi tells them to stay away as Public Security was already investigating it. He says they're not regular blocks, and that Monica Simmons' device had gotten readings from it — as well as similar readings nearby. Unable to leave his post, he winds up agreeing to let them look around. They find two more blocks around Akihabara and return, which causes the bricks to combine and come to life as a giant ToyAgumon. ToyAgumon says it's lonely and wants to play — then attacks them. After they defeat it, it disappears. Shota says it's a strange dangerous creature that can't be allowed to roam free, which offends Hiroko since a kid made it. After Shota leaves to report what happened, Hiroko says the kid is lonely as has no friends and his parents are never around — hence why he made ToyAgumon. She then figured the kid's feelings effected ToyAgumon and that it didn't mean to rampage.

To Do the Job, You Need to Dress the Part

Asuna Shiroki puts out a message saying how many Public Safety staff had gone on leave, causing a staff shortage — and that she needed an energy drink. Yuki takes on the mission, and goes to Akihabara to find her — where Asuna complains about being overworked. Asuna is surprised someone took the request, and assumes she's hallucinating from too many energy drinks. Feeling it's fine to accept help sometimes, she has Yuki go with her to the underground. She has Yuki wear a Public Safety outfit so they can pass as actual staff, with Shota Kuroi annoyed she'd dragged a civilian in to help. An Outer Dungeon suddenly shows up in the middle of his complaining, and so the three of them go into it. They find two Bakemon inside, and defeat them. After the battle, Shota says if Yuki ever impersonates Public Safety again — he'll arrest them. He says he heard the government had sent agents to dig up info on Digimon, assumes Yuki is one of them — tells them to stay out of their business and says they will not be allies the next time they meet.

The Secret Getaway

Hiroko Sagisaka tells Yuki she got more information from social media, with people saying ghosts had been seen in Shinjuku Park. Asuna Shiroki approaches them whilst they're looking around the park and says they should stay away from the forest as she had heard an odd cry there the other day. Instead of heading the warning, Hiroko says she'll help out by using her camera — which Asuna agrees to since video footage may come in handy. Once there, they hear the cries — and quickly find they belong to a Guilmon. It's only able to say its own name, and despite that, Yuki is seemingly able to have a conversation with it by saying "Guil" a bunch of times. It runs into the sewers, with the others following it. When they find it, it attacks them. After defeating it, they note it seemed to just be playing with them and decide not to follow it further into the sewers since it didn't seem to be a threat.

The Father of Shinjuku

Hiroko Sagisaka tells Yuki she had managed to get a reservation with the famous fortune teller in Koshu-Kaido, and asks them to come with her. The fortune teller, known as "The Father of Shinjuku", does Hiroko's reading, and, aware she's a streamer, tells her she can achieve her dream and to be kind to everyone she meets...not just humans. After Hiroko leaves, he motions to do Yuki's fortune — only for Yuki to say they know he's not a human. He says his species isn't important, and that he knew Yuki would arrive today. He asks them to find four Digimon in the real world, as they had gotten lost and were unable to find their way home. He sends them them out to find them one by one, with Yuki's job made harder by the fact the four of them were disguised as humans. Yuki eventually tracks Gaomon, Lalamon, Bukamon, and Datamon down and takes them to fortune teller so he can send them back to Digital World: Iliad. As thanks for helping him, he reveals he's actually AncientWisemon in disguise — though Yuki isn't surprised. This annoys AncientWisemon, as he thought he'd done a good job pretending to be a human.

Between the Worlds

Hiroko Sagisaka texts Yuki saying she's located an anomaly in Akihabara and to meet there. Once there, Yuki finds not Hiroko, but Agumon, who was in front of an Outer Dungeon. He says he has lost Gabumon and was warned to prevent that from happening. He's surprised to see Yuki, but figures it's fine since they have their own Digimon. They go inside, and find Gabumon fighting an Orochimon. Now re-united, they Warp DNA Digivolve together into Omnimon then defeat it with Yuki's help. Once they come out of the Dungeon, they land right in front of Hiroko and Public Safety. Hiroko is annoyed Yuki went without them, and says she hadn't shown up because she had been caught by Public Safety. Yuki lies and says Agumon and Gabumon are their partners to try and keep them safe, but Agumon corrects them and says they already have a partner. He says they need to leave before they get in trouble with their boss, and the duo escape before they can be captured. Public Safety say trouble always happens around Yuki and Hiroko, and as such — they're going to keep a closer eye on the two of them. Hiroko and Asuna Shiroki bond over liking Agumon and Gabumon, leading an annoyed Shota Kuroi to remind her she's at work. Public Safety decide to look around for anything left behind — whilst Yuki and Hiroko leave.

A Delayed Return

A Hagurumon in Central Town says its colleague should be back by now, since the next shift should've started. Yuki overhears and asks what's wrong, with it saying that its friend may be in trouble...though it may also just be asleep since it's lazy. Since it's off duty and isn't allowed to do overtime, it asks Yuki to go check on it in its place. Yuki travels over to Central Tower, and finds the Hagurumon really was asleep. They wake it up, and it panics and leaves since it's not meant to be doing overtime. When Yuki returns, original Hagurumon thanks them for helping out.

The Blacksmith's Request

Zudomon asks Yuki to get him some materials from Central Tower. After Yuki gets them, he thanks them by allowing them to use his store.

Knowledge Is the Death of Fear

An Agumon texts Yuki, saying that some Digimon are scared of humans and that it will visit their house to talk about it. It shows up with Gatomon, who suggests the humans dress up as Digimon to try and make it easier for the scared Digimon to talk to them. Even Aegiomon has to, since they consider him a human due to how much time he spends with them. They go to Patamon and Palmon, who were scared of humans, and are able to befriend them — their Digimon costumes helping. Agumon and Gatomon then thank them for helping their friends get over their phobias.

From Pegasusmon to the World

Pegasusmon texts Yuki saying there's something it wants to do and that it needs their help. It says its there to encourage everyone, and that it needs to keep it up. Yuki notices Pegasusmon's worry, with Pegasusmon saying it can't be helped. Struggling to put its thoughts into words, it wonders if it can use its actions and asks Yuki for Digi-Eggs so its friends can digivolve and get stronger. Yuki has none, leading Pegasusmon to suggest asking Vulcanusmon to make them. He makes them for Yuki, and Yuki returns to Pegasusmon. Pegasusmon uses them on his friends, who Armor Digivolve. The four newly digivolved Armor Digimon join Yuki's party, with Yuki either leaving them in Central Town to protect it or taking them on their journey to fight the Titans.

Back to the Skies

Andromon talks to Yuki about how badly damaged Blimpmon is, and says it'll need a large amount of metal to fix him. Yuki asks the nearby Guardromon for metal, which it happily gives since it was thanks to them production was going smoothly again. Yuki gives it to Andromon, who then repairs Blimpmon.

Quick to Fight, Quick on the Job

Guardromon says to Yuki that the production lines are inoperative, and that the cause is insufficient material. It says LoaderLeomon is the one who moves production material from the mines, and that they've lost contact with it. It asks them to go and find LoaderLeomon and tell it the Titan issue is over and that it needs to deliver the Chrondigizoit Ore. Yuki goes into the mine and finds LoaderLeomon on a drilling rampage, and it attacks them thinking they're a Titan looking to stop its fun. Yuki tells it to contact Guadromon, and it does so saying Titans had shown up in the mine. Guadromon tells it about how the Titans were gone thanks to Yuki, and LoaderLeomon apologizes. They go to Guardromon with its drilled up metals, and says it's realized it's supposed to take the metal to the residents — not just spend all day having fun drilling.

The Trial

Solarmon talks to Yuki about how it can't get a Parrotmon plume for Bearmon from Central Tower because the Titans are in the way. It leaves for the tower, with Yuki following it. Yuki agrees to help, and finds one after defeating the Titans there. Solarmon thanks them, and gives them some items as a reward.

The Craftsman's Partner

Zudomon tells Yuki its hammer is broken, and asks them to get it some Chrondigizoit Metal so it can fix it. Yuki gets some from Guadromon, and gives it Zudomon. Zudomon uses it to fix its hammer.

I Want to Go Someplace Legendary!

With Blimpmon fixed, Coronamon says he wants to go on a trip to the Cosmic Area so he can train there and become strong. Blimpmon tells him he can't take him, as the area is the weather there is both too hot and cold. This relieves Lunamon and disappoints Coronamon. Yuki asks if there was any way he could go, with Blimpmon saying he'd be able to he it had a heater and a cooler. Yuki says they'll get them, with Blimpmon surprised at just how much they wanted to help Coronamon and Lunamon. He says there might be a cooler in the Factorial Area, with Yuki leaving to go find one. Yuki asks Vademon if he has any, and he offers to sell one for 10 million yen. Yuki is able to haggle the price down to 1000 yen, and buys it. They take it Blimpmon, who gets Datamon to install it. He says to tell Coronamon the good news, with a disappointed Lunamon saying guess we're going to Heat Cosmic. Coronamon surprises Lunamon and says he's going alone as only one Digimon can be the strongest. Lunamon protests, but Coronamon gets on Blimpmon before she can finish talking. Blimpmon then flies away. Lunamon worries about him, though quickly changes to anger and says she'll get Minervamon to beat him up when he gets back.

Platinum Numemon's Jewelry

Yuki comes across the Bearmon Brothers and Solarmon whilst in Central Town. Big Bearmon praises Solarmon, saying it brought him a plume, and that it's way cooler than Yuki — unaware it was actually Yuki who got the plume. He offers Yuki a chance to "redeem themselves", and that they're going to the underground to steal PlatinumNumemon's jewelry. Once inside, the group beat up a group of Geremon under the mistaken assumption they were PlatinumNumemon. The actual PlatinumNumemon was watching the battle, with the group unaware. They look around for the jewelry, and find some cut glass. Solarmon and Little Bearmon think its treasure, though Big Bearmon is fully aware it's worthless and says they need the find the real jewelry. They say they're tired, and will just have to try again another day. They say they should ask at the tavern about the jewelry, and leave. Having heard this tip, Yuki goes there before them and talks to Deputymon about what happened. He tells them the Digimon they fought weren't PlatinumNumemon, and that the real one is Platinum and hangs out deep in the sewers. Yuki travels through the entire sewer, but is unable to find it...unaware it was following them the entire time. Yuki returns to the entrance, and just before leaving — turns around. They finally see PlatinumNumemon, and have their Digimon defeat it — acquiring the jewelry. Yuki shows off it off the trio, and Big Bearmon asks if he can have it. Yuki says they'll trade for it, and Big Bearmon offer to give them their special item for it — despite Little Bearmon's protests. Yuki then either does the trade, or gives it them for free.

A Missing Friend

Whilst in Central Town, Yuki sees a Motimon telling Agumon and Gabumon that its and its friends had been attacked whilst they were playing in the the Abyss Area. This caused them to get split up. Unfamiliar with Digital World: Iliad, they say have no clue what could've attacked them. Yuki asks if they can help, and they happily allow them to join the search. They go to to the Abyss Area, and find a Punimon being attacked by one of the remaining Titan — Scorpiomon. Agumon and Gabumon become Omnimon and defeat it with Yuki's help. Punimon thanks them for saving it, though quickly realises Motimon wasn't around. The group calm it down and take it to Central Town, reuniting the two baby Digimon. They offer them a reward, with the Yuki taking it since Agumon and Gabumon had no use for it. Agumon wonders what the Titans were up to, and he and Gabumon leave to look into it.

Impatience and Determination

Lunamon texts Yuki, saying she can't go on like this and to come talk to her. Blimpmon had returned from the Cosmic Area, but Coronamon hadn't — and Lunamon felt like she needed to take action. She says she needs to go to the Cosmic Area too, though decides she'd rather not go to the same place Coronamon went to — so decides to go to Chill Cosmic instead of Heat Cosmic. Blimpmon says he can't go as he doesn't have a heater, and has no idea where to get one. Yuki says they'll find one, and Blimpmon excitedly says he knows they'll be able to find one. Lunamon says she'll help look, and remembers seeing one inside one of of the houses in Central Town. Whilst checking houses, Yuki come across a Betamon who says its heater had been stolen by a Goblimon. Yuki says they'll track it down, though Betamon says it doesn't matter as it was faulty so it was just gong to buy a new one. Yuki finds a group of Goblimon in town and asks if one of them stole a heater, with the thief surprised Yuki knew. Yuki retries the heater and takes it to Blimpmon. Lunamo arrives and says she couldn't find one, though Blimpmon says it doesn't matter as it has one now. Blimpmon has Datamon fix it and install it, then takes Lunamon to Chill Cosmic.

The Color the Water Speaks Of

A Kamemon texts Yuki, saying they're all alone and is having trouble with something. It says it thinks the the Titans didn't leave because of Yuki, they probably left because they'd already achieved everything they wanted to. It notes the sea breeze smells different, and that Shellmon would know if something was up if she was here. They go to Shellmon's house in the hopes they could find a device to measure water quality. They find Shellmon's diary and end up reading it, with Kamemon finding an entry about water quality. If the plants are blue, it's fine — if they're purple, they're hurtful. It even says where the exact plants to check are. They go there, though Kamemon says it can't swim — meaning Yuki has to. Yuki swims through a group of Syakomon, and eventually finds the specific plant. It's purple, meaning the water is contaminated. This has it realize why the breeze smelled off, and it gives them items as thanks. It says it'll stay in the area and keep an eye on things.

Divermon's Woes

Divermon texts Yuki, saying how it was weird that Sharkmon backed down and that they should investigate the ocean floor. They travel around with the help of Submarimon, and find a spot where it's hard to breathe. They hear a voice saying to "give it back", and get attacked by a Crabmon who demands they return the current. Crabmon doesn't remember anything after the battle, and last remembered struggling to breathe. Divermon says he was right, and that he knew Sharkmon wouldn't have gone down quietly. He had clearly done something to the current. Divermon says his new plan was to become leader of the ocean Titans in Sharkmon's place, and that when becomes leader he'll order them to not cause any trouble. They then leave the area to avoid losing their minds like Crabmon had.

Proper Beach Attire

A Wanyamon from Central Town messages Yuki, saying they'd gone to the Abyss Area but that no one was there. When Yuki, Inori Misono, and Aegiomon arrive, it asks them to put on swimsuits and then swim in the ocean with it. They get changed and go there, but get attacked by a territorial Seadramon. After they win, it flees and says it's telling its boss. MegaSeadramon and WaruSeadramon show up, upset they had beat up Seadramon — and attack them assuming they're Titans. After losing, they also say they're going to tell their boss — though MetalSeadramon shows up and says they don't need to as Seadramon had already told it about the Titan invasion. It misunderstandings them wanting to have fun in the ocean as invading, and attacks them as well. Once defeated, MetalSeadramon surrenders and says the ocean is theirs. They turn it down and say they're not Titans, and tell them they're the ones who defeated the Titans in the first place. MetalSeadramon apologizes, and lets them play. They play together in the the water for a while, with Wanyamon rewarding them as thanks once they're done.

Secret of the Hidden Honey Base

A Muchomon texts Yuki, saying it had been attacked by bees. When Yuki goes to it, it says there's a hidden honey base belonging to the FunBeemon nearby, and that they had attacked it when it tried to steal some of the honey. It says there are probably Digimon scared of them, and then says the Titans were probably behind it and plan to immobilize everyone with FunBeemon. Yuki believes this, and Muchomon sends them to destroy the honey base. They destroy it, beat up all the FunBeemon, and return to Muchomon — who thanks them for doing so.

The Mighty Bearmon Brothers

The Bearmon Brothers message Yuki, saying they're going to patrol Gear Forest to keep it safe. Yuki travels there and finds them searching for Titans. Yuki tells them they had already defeated the Titans, which upsets the Bearmon Brothers. They decide the ones Yuki defeated were just small fry, and figure the real ones must be hiding somewhere. Big Bearmon runs off to go find the supposed bosses, leaving Little Bearmon behind since he was worried about them fighting the bosses. Little Bearmon asks for Yuki's help, and Yuki agrees. They search around and are actually able to find a member of the Titans, Minotarumon. After defeating it, Little Bearmon worries his brother was fighting one too — and so they look around for him. They find him fighting Greymon, another Titan, and help him defeat it. Big Bearmon says they aren't strong enough as they are right now, and Little Bearmon becomes upset realizing his brother doesn't want to be with him any more. Big Bearmon says there may be times they're not together, and so they need to be strong enough to fight by themselves. He has them promise that no matter what happens between them, they would meet again at the nearby tree. They thank Yuki for their help, and give them a reward. Yuki checks out the tree, and sees they had buried a note in a box saying the two brothers would bring peace to Digital World: Iliad together.

Listen to the Voice

JumboGamemon texts Yuki, saying its stuck in stuck in jail in the Abyss Sanctuary. When Yuki arrives, it says it was the Kamemon they knew eight years ago and had found a vein of Chrondigizoit Ore there but had also managed to get stuck in a Titan trap. It says it had tried to break out, but that the cell was too strong. Yuki realizes only Neptunemon could help, and says they'll go talk to him. JumboGamemon is happy to hear this, saying the other Digimon hadn't listened to him and had refused to help. Yuki explains this to Neptunemon, who is shocked to hear about such cells. He agrees to free it, and JumboGamemon is shocked they were able to get Neptunemon to come. He apologizes for not coming sooner, and frees it — also saying he was impressed it had found the ore. Neptunemon asks it to come with him, but it refuses as it doesn't trust him. Neptuemon promises to never have him go through something so bad again, and it decides to trust him. Neptunemon thanks Yuki, and rewards them.

Message from Beyond Time

Big Drimogemon and Little Drimogemon message Yuuki, saying they will defeat the Titans and make Gear Forest peaceful again. When Yuki goes to them, they talk about how they were inspired by the legendary Bearmon Brothers. They argue about if they should go left or right, and end the argument ends up so bad that they end their brothership. Yuki finds Little Drimogemon fighting a Groundramon and helps him defeat it. After the battle, Little Drimogemon says he's sad about the break up and leaves to go visit the Bearmon Brother's sanctuary to think. Yuki later finds Big Drimogemon fighting a WarGrowlmon, and helps him as well. He tries to celebrate the win with his brother, though ends up remembering he's not there. Sad, he too goes to the sanctuary. Yuki finds an ashamed Little at the shrine, with him saying the legendary brothers wouldn't want him there since he argued with his own brother. Big shows up, and Little tries to apologize. Big notices something buried in the ground before he can though, and the two brothers dig it up. They uncover the note the Bearmon Brothers had written eight years in the past, and figure it must've come to them as the the legendary brothers were telling them to always stick together. They make up and keep the note as a symbol of the lesson they learned from the legendary brothers. They then reward Yuki as thanks for helping them beat up some Titans.

Hidden Honey Base Strikes Back

Peckmon messages Yuki, saying the Gear Forest is in trouble because of the bees. When Yuki goes to Peckmon, it says it was the Muchomon who had asked them to deal with the FunBeemon eight years earlier. It shows Yuki a letter it got, which demands the one who destroyed their bases goes to the Shade Tree Pier so that they can get their revenge — and if they don't, the bees would attack the village. Peckmon had realized the bees weren't Titans, and says to try and sort things out with them. Yuki finds a TigerVespamon at the base, who was a digivolved FunBeemon that had been waiting to years get revenge. Yuki defeats it, and it submits itself to Yuki saying the strong controls the weak. Yuki tries to befriend it, though it refuses and instead decides to retire and move into the village. When they return to Peckmon, it says TigeVespamon showed up and asked to help rebuild the town and — and that Peckmon itself had apologised for assuming they were Titans and causing the entire issue.

The Greatest OMNI Carnival

Volcanomon invites Yuki and the others to the The Greatest OMNI Carnival tournament as it was impressed they were a double Champion. Yuki fights their way to the final, and eventually defeats Marsmon to become a triple champion.

How to Cheer Up a Warrior

Marsmon messages Yuki, asking what they should do with the Paradise Colosseum now Callismon was gone. When Yuki visits him, he says how sad he was about having to defeat his brother and asks what humans do to help them feel better. Yuki suggests watching a movie, and takes Marsmon to Hiroko Sagisaka. She suggests the movie "Yesterday's George", which is a boxing movie where the boxer nearly kills his opponent. Marsmon relates to this, and says he can bounce back like the boxer had. He decides to go back to the underground Colosseum, and challenges Yuki to a fight when they arrive. Yuki wins, and Marsmon realizes he's too scared to use his full strength after using it to defeat his brother. Worrying about it makes him hungry, and they agree to eat together. They eat lots of food together, which makes him feel better. He remembers his brother once saying you can't protect Digital World: Iliad on an empty stomach, and feels like he can fight again. He challenges Yuki again, and says to go to the Paradise Colosseum when they're ready for a proper rematch.

Stuck in the Restroom

A clerk at the coffee shop messages Yuki, saying someone had locked themselves in the toilet and was muttering about their captain and a weapon. Yuki says they're certain they know who it is, and is proven right when it's Shota Kuroi. They hear his complaints and knock on the door, and he recognizes Yuki's voice. Despite telling Yuki to go away, he opens up to them and talks about how much hates Digimon due to what happened to Kodai Kuremi. Yuki tries to calm him down, but he says how nothing will change his mind and that he had agreed to pilot a weapon that will let him get revenge against Digimon. He's surprised when Yuki show concern for him, and says he'll take their words into consideration. Talking about it helped him feel better, though he says it changes nothing and they're still enemies. He refuses to leave still, and Yuki leaves the shop. Seconds later, the clerk stops them says the guy came out and had asked him to give Yuki a reward as thanks.

In the Palm of an Unknown Hand

Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki, saying she got a creepy messages and to meet her in Higashi-Shinjuku. When they get there, she says the messages asked her to to sneak into a D-SAT vehicle and that she felt like the person had been watching her the entire time. This is proven true when she receives a new message saying to tell Yuki to dress in something cyber. Yuki puts on the same outfit Aiba wears, and they get a new message telling them to pick up an ID card and a USB drive from nearby. After they get them, they get a message telling them to get into the D-SAT vehicle in Shinjuku Park. Once they arrive, they see D-SAT staff and assume they have no chance of getting in — only to see the staff leave after getting reports that Digimon had escaped from the Digimon District. They use Kodai Kuremi's ID to get into the vehicle, then insert the USB into the computer inside after being told to do so in another message. The computer loads data about an upcoming project created by Jindai Technology, Project EDEN — as well as diary entries from a scientist who hates Yuya and Monica Simmons. Once done, they're told to leave the ID and USB on the bench nearby and that their reward is also there. Once they leave, a pleased Kyoko Kuremi says how that'll clear things up and will help her learn what "you know who" had been up to. She then leaves as well.

The Easy Road Is Best

ZubaEagermon messages Yuki, saying it was confused as it still doesn't know what "Twentiest" means and asks them to visit them in a back alley in Shinjuku. Yuki says they don't know the answer either, and it says it feels like its road to the Twentiest is gone as it doesn't know what's "in" any more. It says it's annoyed at being normal, and that the Twentiest is supposed to stand out. They mention how Yuki stands out due to their silly outfit, then realizes that helped them get closer to being the Twentiest. They ask to see more of Yuki's clothes, and specifically request clothes with Digimon on them. Yuki puts some on, and ZubeEagermon loves them so much it declares their outfit is Twentiest. It realizes being Twentiest is having extra flair that goes beyond normal fashion, and says it had been trying too hard — the more you try to be Twentiest, the further away from it you get. Having finally realized what the Twentiest is, it digivolves to Duramon. It says being normal is fine, and then says it's to going to the arena in the Factorial Area. When Yuki visits, it says it had put in "normal" effort for "normal" wins, but found it boring. It de-digivolves back to ZubaEagermon, and says it will step away from the path of the normal and will try to stand out again. It digivolves again, this time to Grademon — and says it has rediscovered the path of the Twentiest. It challenges Yuki to battle, and asks them to fight it in the Paradise Colosseum when they're ready.

I Don't Belong Anywhere Yet

MarineAngemon messages Yuki, saying that no one in the Warrior's Watering Hole respects their cuteness and that someone needs to heal their weary spirit. When Yuki visits, it says that it had wanted to be a star across the entirety of Digital World: Iliad, but that no one cared and it missed the ocean. It asks Yuki to bring it a bottle of ocean water, and so Yuki goes to the Abyss Area and gets some. Regardless of the water Yuki gets, MarineAngemon hates it as it's not from the depths. MarineAngemon runs away, and when Yuki finds it it says it'll return to the sea as that's where its fans are. When Yuki returns to the Abyss Area, they see the residents fawning over delighted MarineAngemon. It thanks Yuki and rewards them, as they were the one who got convinced it to return.

A Gift from the Hosts

Mirei messages Yuki; saying King Drasil, Homeros, and Kunlun want to talk to them. Yuki goes to the In-Between Theater and visits them, with them giving Yuki the power to time travel to any time and place they had been to before. They say they did this because Yuki had had some difficulties recently and that it would help them prepare for the battle agaisnt Chronomon.

Longing for Akihabara

Yuki time travels to the past, and receives a message from Vulcanusmon who says he had got a part from an excellent action figure but that he needed advice about it. He shows them the action figure hand, and asks them to go to Akihabara to find a figure from the same series as that one. He gives them the hand and a receipt that was with it, and when Yuki goes to the store they run into Monica Simmons. She's surprised to learn that Yuki is into action figures as well, and becomes even more surprised to see them with the hand of a figure from a limited edition Sayori Magical Girl figure. Yuki says why they were actually there, and Monica suggests a specific Sayori figure saying their client would love it. Yuki tries to buy it, though when the clerk says it's ¥600,000 they protest and say it's too much. Monica steps in and says she'll buy it for them if it's for a Digimon, and asks them to explain one day why they needed it. Yuki takes the figure to Vulcanusmon, who is delighted with it.

Final Battle Challenger

Merukimon messages Yuki, asking them to visit him as he has a problem. When they arrive, they see Pharaohmon and Rapidmon (Armor) begging to be in the front lines for the next battle as they had been unable to help retake Central Town — with Merukimon apprehensive. He asks Yuki to talk to them, and they say they became strong by living in harsh conditions and rescuing Digimon from the Titans, but wanted to become stronger as they had struggled in their battles against said Titans. Though he was moved by their words, he was worried about letting them join as he didn't know their strength as well as the upcoming battle being more dangerous than any other. Yuki suggests testing their strength in the colosseum, and Merukimon agrees and tasks Yuki to do it as he is too busy to do it himself. After the battle, regardless of Yuki's answer, they say they're joining the fight — with this annoying Merukimon. He no longer minded though, as he had seen they were strong enough to put up a decent fight against Yuki.

Memories of Bonds

A cosplayer messages Yuki saying there's two amazing cosplayers in Akihabara and that they should go see them. Once Yuki meets up with the cosplayer, they point them in the direct of the two amazing ones and Yuki goes to find them. Yuki finds them and learns they're not cosplayers, it's just Asuna Shiroki and BeelStarmon. Yuki eavesdrops on their conversation, where the duo reminisce about how BlackGatomon digivolved to BeelStarmon in response to Asuna becoming her friend. They also talk about how much they've improved each other. They notice Yuki had been eavesdropping, and say how Yuki was actually part of that moment too — and so thank them as they helped them to become friends.

A Stubborn Fog

Yuki time travels to the past, and receives a message from a Punimon who says the fog was so bad it got scared and returned to Gear Forest.
