When Yuki goes back to her, she says she felt something warm in her chest — as well as tightness and pain — and says she's going to stay in the village to figure out what it is. Triumph is Mine Minervamon says she needs to do something about the feeling, and asks Yuki to come talk to her in Rebellion Village. When Yuki does, Minervamon demands they fight her. She says she's felt weird ever since seeing Yuki's Beelzemon , and, unable to to put it into words, decided she needed to fight Yuki. She figures beating Yuki would put her mind at ease, as Yuki hangs out with tough Digimon — though ends up being defeated. She complains about the loss, and says she needs to get stronger before the battle against Chronomon . She says her feelings held her back, and so she needs to shut herself away until she becomes stronger. Something surges within her, and she thinks she's about to digivolve... but then nothing happens. It helped clear her mind though, so she thanks Yuki and gives them a reward. Minervamon's Decision Minervamon messages Yuki , saying she needs to tell them about something that's bothering her and to meet her at her house in Central Town . She says she heard the Beelzemon of the Seven Great Demon Lords was near the Factorial Area , and asks Yuki to go with them to see. They find him, and he says he would usually kill them — but can't as his guns and Behemoth are out of commission. Yuki suggests attacking Beelzemon whilst he was weakened, but Minervamon refuses as she wouldn't be satisfised with a win like that. They offer to help fix them, so that they can fight him in a fair battle. He agrees, and they get the materials for him. He fixes them, then fights them in the coliseum as Beelzemon BM. Minervamon and Yuki win, and Beelzemon leaves as promised. Minervamon says she feels a weight has been lifted as she no longer finds herself admiring another and says she needs to better herself. She then thanks Yuki for their help and gives them a reward. The Helper from Shambala Kunlun messages Yuki and asks them to come visit him. When Yuki does, he explains that he's the Host Computer of Digital World: Shambala and that the Digimon he brought with him — Susanoomon and a few others — hadn't been in contact lately and that they seem to be having too much fun in Digital World: Iliad . He says they went to the Paradise Colosseum to train, and asks Yuki to go there and remind them of their mission. The Forgetful Helpers Yuki goes to the Paradise Colosseum and finds three of Kunlun 's helpers, Kotemon , Musyamon , and Zanbamon . Yuki mentions they were sent by Kunlun, and they remember they hadn't been in contact for a while. They say they had come to train and had just lost track of time, an figure Yuki must be a strong warrior from Digital World: Iliad to have been sent by Kunlun. As they find the Colosseum too fun, they refuse orders and say they'll only listen if Yuki can defeat them in battle. Yuki defeats them, though they say it isn't over as they still need to defeat Susanomon . Susanomon the Hero Yuki defeats Susanomon , and so, as agreed, it, Kotemon , Musyamon , and Zanbamon contact Kunlun and leave to join the Royal Knights at Central Tower . Scariest Face in the World Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , saying she got a tip about a missing person's case and asks them to come and help her with it. She says a girl named Kurumi messaged her, with them reading her email to see that her Instructor Saburo Miura had gone missing. She says there's a ghost story at her school that claims there's a red book in the library that you can't stop reading once you start it. Once you finish it you feel a tap on the back, then see the scariest face in the world when you turn around. This caused all the students to become scared of reading, which upset Mr Miura. To try and prove the story wrong he read the book, which was about his own life. This scared him, and he continued to read — even refusing to return to class so he could finish the book. She says there were sightings of him at Shinjuku Park, with the witness reports saying he was still reading the book. Yuki suggests going to the park, but Hiroko turns them down saying she wants to look into something first. Hiroko goes on her own, and finds the book on the bench. She starts reading it, with the book being about her own life as well. Hours later, when Hiroko finishes the book, a man appears behind her. The Operator contacts Yuki and says they had been tracking Hiroko, and that she had just gone into the sewers after spending hours at Shinjuku Park. Yuki goes to where Hiroko's signal vanishes, and finds and Outer Dungeon. Once inside, Yuki finds a Wendigomon with lots of humans. It admits to having made the book, says how much fun it was to scare humans — and that it is able to harvest lots of energy from them. It attacks Yuki, though is defeated. Yuki saves them, and Hiroko admits she was captured on purpose as that was the quickest way to be able to solve it. They return all the humans to the human world, where they lie to Miura and say they and Kurumi found him passed out. He thanks them for their help, and he goes home to rest. Kurumi then thanks them for their help. Fulfilling a Great Ambition Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , saying there's someone she wants them to meet. Once Yuki arrives at the detective agency, she introduces them to Norio — a supposed time traveller from the past. He says he originated from eight years ago, and was caught up in an explosion (the same one that sent Yuki eight years into the future as well). Since the same thing happened to Yuki, Hiroko figured they were the best person for the job. Yuki takes him to Mirei Mikagura , who confirms he had indeed travelled in time — and attempts to send him back to the past. Instead of return to the past, he and Yuiki end up in an Outer Dungeon. Millenniummon refuses to let him return to his own time, and attacks him — though Yuki is able to defeat it and protect him. Defeated, Millenniummon says it will let him alone — but still plans to enjoy itself. Yuki takes Norio to the past, then returns to the present. Norio from the present shows up, and says he thinks the young version of himself will show up again and that he had actually visited his future self before going to Hiroko. This had caused issues, as the original present version of Norio was a rich successful business man that was married to Hanae — the girl he had a crush on — and that the current version was a broke single man as he had assumed his life would be successful so partied instead of working hard. He asks them to help him fake their meeting, as past Nori seeing current would cause the timeline to shift even further and cause current Norio to cease to exist. They rent a suit and convince Hanae to pretend she's married to him, which she agrees to as she thinks it'd be fun to pretend she's a private investigator. Past Norio is impressed, though Hanae bursts the bubble and says she can't do it any more — admitting the truth. Present Norio explains what happened, and a distraught past asks to return to the his own time period. Before Yuki can do so, Hiroko brings up that the entire situation was weird — Yuki and Inori Misono disappeared for eight years, whist Norio didn't. Millenniummon, who had seemingly been watching everything, says Hiroko was smart to notice — and summons everyone back to the Outer Dunegon. It says it had taken an interest in Norio, and that what she mentioned had happened as it messed with space-time to allow it. Not wanting its fun to be over, it attacks them again — but is defeated again. It begs to be killed, though both Norio say it's fine and they didn't mind what had happened and even saw it as a pleasant experience. Millenniummon apologizes, and tells the past Norio to live a good life. Yuki has Mirei send him to the past again, where he says he will make sure not to become a loser in the future. When Yuki returns to the present, the timeline changes again — this time, they actually are married and Norio was a successful businessman. Observing the Underworld Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , saying she found a picture of herself from high school and that they should come reminisce with her over it. It's a picture of her class, and she recognises and realises that Kinshiro Eriito — a guy who once asked her to help find his parents — was in her class back then. She wasn't able to help him, and says she wishes they could go back in time as she thinks Yuki would be able to help find them. Yuki travels back in time eight years, and goes to Shinjuku Park — where Hiroko had said she'd met up with him back then. Yuki finds Kinshiro, and the teenage Hiroko is surprised to see Yuki was already there. They both explain that he's a genius, and they explain that he had never met his parents — he was a designer baby made through donated DNA. Kinshiro mocks regular humans, and compares them to primates — saying he only goes to high school because he wanted to study dumb people and see how they live in such squalor. Hiroko mentions Monica Simmons is likely familiar with the lab, and they track her down with the help of Asuna Shiroki . They find her being attacked by a group of Piximon , leading Yuki to save her. They explain Kinshiro story to her, and she says the data is probably top secret and thus they'll have to hack to get access to it. Kinshiro says he already tried and that his computer wasn't powerful enough, and she says it's fine as they can use hers and she wanted to look into them anyway as she's heard they're doing illegal genetic modifications. She performs the hack, and and tells him that his parents were chimpanzees. This upsets him, since it means he can't talk to them. That's not all though, Kinshiro will eventually turn into a chimpanzee. After he ran away, Hiroko asks how long he has — and she says in eight years he'll be a full primate. Yuki returns to the present, and finds a human Kinshiro in Seibu-Shinjuku. Kinshiro recognises Yuki, and says he and some others found a way to have him remain human. Doing so helped him learn to appreciate others, and he ended enjoying meeting his parents. As thanks for helping out eight years ago, he gives them a reward. Royal Knights, Assemble! King Drasil messages Yuki , saying she needs their help. Yuki travels to the VIP room of the In-Between Theater, in which King Drasil is with Agumon and Gabumon . They mention to King Drasil how they were already familiar with Yuki, and how strong they are — saying they can help them for sure. She says she was in Digital World: Iliad as it was in trouble, and that she had brought the Royal Knights with her. As they were unfamiliar with this world, they all got lost — and as such, she asks Yuki to go find them all and get them to gather at Central Tower . She says it will be hard, as she had given them human forms — and Yuki goes to the rendezvous point with Agumon and Gabumon (who are one of the Royal Knights as Omnimon ). They give Yuki some supplies, then send them off to find their allies. Knowing One's Strength Craniamon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he was at Central Tower but that he wasn't sure of himself as everyone in Digital World: Illiad was strong. Yuki finds him wounded, and he explains he had fought enemies on the way there. He asks if Yuki thinks he can be of use in his current state, and Yuki suggests to ask a fortune teller. They go to the one in Shinjuku , who was actually AncientWisemon (though Craniamon was unaware of this). He tells Craninamon (who was in his human disguise) to go to subroad, and that he will get his answer from a man there that is eating a crepe. They travel there, and the man says it must be Digimon related when he mentions he was sent by a fortune teller. They explain how Craniamon had lost his confidence, and the man says how he knows that the "human" was Craniamon. He says the best way to deal with it is to challenge the strongest Titan — Plutomon . They travel to the Dark Field together, where Craniamon challenges Plutomon. He turns it down, and says he cannot fight a Royal Knight as everyone would take it too seriously. He instead tells Craniamon to challenge Enbarrmon, the immortal steed, and says he'll personally take him to Enbarrmon as fate had brought them together. Crainamon thanks Yuki for their helpp, and says he's going to go fight Enbarrmon. Showdown with the Immortal Steed Yuki , Craniamon , and Plutomon challenge Enbarrmon — the goal being helping Crainamon to win so he can regain his confidence. They defeat it, and Enbarrmon says it enjoyed the battle. Plutomon says that means it considers Craniamon worthy, and Enbarrmon proves this by allowing Craniamon to ride it. This causes them to become Craniamon + Enbarrmon, with Craniamon happy as the addition of flight has him feeling more powerful. Yuki reminds him to go to the rendezvous point, and so he does so — taking his new steed with him. Plutomon was also happy, as it meant the rampaging Enbarrmon had been dealt with. Secrets Are for Sharing A Bakemon messages messages Yuki , saying something scary was happening in Plutomon 's castle and that it was too scared to investigate itself. Yuki meets up with it, and it says it senses a powerful aura inside the castle. Once Yuki goes inside, they see Plutomon having a meeting with Imperialdramon FM . Imperialdramon says that it was actually the "human" who helped them with Craniamon , and that it was returning to the human world as it knew Dark Field was safe in Plutomon's hands. Plutomon had actually sent Imperialdramon as an undercover agent, his mission being to protect the human world...though Imperialdramon only really cared about the human world's sweets. Imperialdramon invites Yuki to a sweets festival, and Plutomon notices Yuki's disappointment over non-seriousness of their conversation. Yuki returns to Bakemo and says it had sensed Imperialdramon, and it says it's glad Plutomon is okay. One Shield Maker's Struggle Gallantmon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he had gone to Factorial Town to repair his equipment. Yuki goes to him and reminds him he needs to go to the rendezvous point, but he says he can't as his equipment got destroyed by a firewall. He came to this area to get Chrondigizoit to fix it, but noticed the area was crawling with evil Digimon. Not wanting to damage his equipment even further, he asks Yuki for help. They go into the mines, and find a rampaging Chaosdramon in the way. It refuses to leave, wanting all the Chrondigizoit for itself — and so the two of them beat it up. Chaosdramon runs away, allowing Gallantmon to use the Chrondigizoit to repair its equipment. Chaosdramon shows up and attacks them again, wanting revenge — but loses even quicker than last time thanks to Gallantmon being back at full strength. He thanks Yuki for their help and agrees to go to the rendezvous point after giving Yuki a reward. Veemon's Growth Veemon messages Yuki , saying he was in the sanctuary in Gear Forest with a human hating WereGarurumon . Yuki goes to them, and WereGarurumon says it knew a human would show up eventually and that humans were dangerous if they could sense the area's energy. Veemon says WereGarurumon is being too negative, but WereGarurumon says Veemon just doesn't understand and that he should talk to Yuki as they're a human to learn what humans are like. After WereGarurumon leaves, Veemon asks if humans are dangerous, though says he'll just go to the human world and decide himself if it was actually true. He says for Yuki to take him somewhere that'll help him understand humans, and so Yuki takes him to various restaurants. Veemon is happy with this, as the best way to learn people's culture is through your stomach — and eats some ice cream. Veemon loves it, and says he's happy to have learned about humans. They go back to the sanctuary, where Veemon digivolves to Magnamon and says he was actually one of the Royal Knights . He loved the ice cream so much he decides he wants to defend humanity, and says he's going to go to the mines to refine his armor. He then thanks Yuki for their help. Bring Your Own Materials Magnamon messages Yuki , saying he was in Factorial Town and needed help fixing his armor. Yuki visits him, and he says he travelled here as he needed Chrondigizoit Metal to repair his armor. There was an issue though... and Guardromon explain there was currently a shortage Chrondigizoit Ore — one of the materials used to make the Metal. LoaderLeomon 's mine hadn't got enough lately, and so Guadromon says it'll take them to a different mine and that they can go mine in there and help out. Though he would usually do it by himself, Magnamon asks Yuki to help as he wants to guarantee success. They find some, and get attacked by an angry Breakdramon who accuses them of stealing it. It doesn't care that Mangamon got permission, and says it all belongs to it. Yuki fights it, and tells Magnamon to repair its armor whilst they do. Magnamon repairs his armor and joins the fight half way in, and helps them to defeat it. Magnamon then thanks them for their help. The Call of the Unseen Examon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he was at Central Tower but that no one could see him. Once Yuki goes there, they hear a buzzing sound and assume its a fly (it's a mini Examon). The "fly" continues to make sounds, though Yuki is only able to hear parts of what mini Examon is saying. Examon is eventually able to get through, and introduces himself. He says he was always told he was too big, so made himself smaller — but went overboard. Unable to fix it, he asks Yuki for help. Yuki mentions a growth medicine, and Examon demands Yuki take him to some. Yuki takes him to Venusmon , who actually has said medicine... though shes unable to see Examon. She scatters it all over in the hopes some would land on him, and some does — making him slightly bigger. Venusmon is now able to see him, and they leave her house so they can continue increasing his size. As he gets bigger, a HerculesKabuterimon and its minions show up and attack Examon. The trio defeat the Titans , and Examon returns to his regular size after the battle. Now back to his regular size, he thanks Yuki and goes to the rendezvous point. The Worthy UlforceVeedramon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he went to the Abyss Santuary to repair his armor but that he doesn't know how to get a meeting with Neptunemon . Yuki meets up with him, where he says he had wanted to talk to Neptunemon as he had Blue Digizoid armor — but that he knows its a rare material and so he'd seen suspicious by wanting it. Yuki offers to introduce them, and takes him to Neptunemon. UlforceVeedramon explains the predicament, and Neptunemon says he uses the Chrondigizoit vein shown to him by JumboGamemon to repair his armor. UlforceVeedramon asks if he can have some, though Neptunemon says he can't just give it to anyone. UlforceVeedramon takes this as a test to prove himself, which Neptunemon confirms. He challenges UlforceVeedramon to battle, though says they should go somewhere else to even things out as he has the advantage underwater. UlforceVeedramon doesn't mind, though Neptunemon insists on a fair battle and allows Yuki to join in as that'd even things out. They defeat Neptunemon, and he acknowledges the knight's strength and agrees to share the Ore with him. He sends JumboGamemon to Factorial Town to process it, and asks Yuki to return after they've finished helping UlforceVeedramon. They go to Factorial Town, where UlforceVeedramon gets the metal. He thanks Yuki for their help, then goes to the rendezvous point. To My Dearest Neptunemon messages Yuki , saying he still has some Blue Digizoid left over and wants to ask a favor from them. Once Yuki arrives, he says he made a ring with the left over Blue Digizoid from when they fixed UlforceVeedramon 's shield, and says he heard humans give rings to the one they find the most dear. Yuki confirms this, and Neptunemon says he wants to give it to Venusmon as thanks for returning his scarf. Rather than give it himself though, he asks Yuki to take it to her. Yuki travels to Central Town and gives it to her, and she's surprised to receive such a precious gift. She thinks, then remembers about Neptunemon telling her about Christmas and assumes it must be a Christmas present. She gives Yuki some medicine, and says to take it to Neptunemon as her Christmas present to him. Yuki takes it to him, and he's confused to receive it. Despite her seemingly not understanding his expression of gratitude, he still found himself satisfied — then says he tends not to understand his own feelings as well and had made the ring without thinking. Duels Must Be Fair Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , saying she got a sus tip about Phase Electron Lifeform sightings. When Yuki goes to her, she says she finds the tipster more suspicious than the tip itself and says it was about a strange cosplayer in Higashi-Shinjuku. They wonder if the tipster was Kosuke Misono , with Hiroko also wondering why a Digimon would disguise itself as a human. Finding it interesting, she asks Yuki to meet up at the Koma Theater Square where the cosplayer had been seen. Upon arrival, they see Dynasmon being mocked by humans. This angers him, with him thinking they had no chivalry. Hiroko says he had been challenging people to duels for a while, but that no one had taken him seriously. She suggests for Yuki to talk to him, though says to be careful as it'll probably end up in a duel challenge. This is proven true, as Dynasmon challenges Yuki within seconds. Yuki accepts, and defeats Dynasmon. After the battle, Dynasmon notices something was amiss — and a Megadramon spawns. Dynasmon says he wont be able to defeat it alone, and asks for Yuki's help. They defeat it, and after the battle — he praises Yuki's stregnth and says they are worthy of carrying out King Drasil 's orders (showing he knew who Yuki was the whole time). Satisifed, he leaves to go to the rendezvous point. Hiroko praises their fightings skills as well, and wonerrs again about why Kosuke would send her the tip. She figures he was testing her, and that he would've had other ways to deal with it had she failed. She then gives Yuki a reward for helping. A Facilitator's Woes A Lalamon messages Yuki , saying it was relaxing in the Shaded Woods and saw a strong Digimon show up. Yuki shows up, and the Lalamon says they should leave as the strong Digimon was rampaging. Yuki asks if it was a Titan, though it says no and that the strong Digimon was beating up Titans too. Despite the warning, Yuki goes further into the forest and is attacked by Leopardmon LM — who says he was annoyed by everyone being selfish and that he cannot please everyone. Leopardmon snaps out of it after the battle, and thanks Yuki for stopping him. He Mode Changes into regular Leopardmon , and introduces himself as the leader of the Royal Knights . He clarifies he was upset at them, as he had tried to assemble them but they had all scattered everywhere. He had ended up alone and became one with nature, which caused him to lose track of time. Yuki relays King Drasil 's message about the Knights going to Central Tower , but Leopardmon says he doesn't feel confident about his leadership skills at the moment so will go there after some time spent reflecting. He then gives Yuki a reward for helping him remember his true goals. Find a Lead Vocalist! Bacchusmon messages Yuki , saying a band would make the party more lively. Yuki visits him, where a Kabuterimon mentions having a choir but not lead vocalist. Bacchusmon says ShogunGekomon is perfect for that role, and sends Yuki out with the mission to convince him to sing. Leopardmon also decides to help search, as his prowess as a lead vocalist intrigues him. They both find him in the sanctuary, and find him fighting a GranKuwagamon . They defeat it, and and ask him to join the band. He agrees, and they all return to Bacchusmon. ShogunGekomon then sings for everyone. Leopardmon enjoys it so much, he decides they need to preserve Digital World: Iliad . Fertilizer for the Soul Sirenmon , in sprout form, messages Yuki saying that there's a lot of hustle and bustle in the village and is missing out duel to being a sprout. Yuki visits, and Sirenmon talks about how she can hear the lovely singing from there — wishing she could hear it from closer up. Yuki says they'll bring the singers to her, which makes Sirenmon really happy. Yuki asks them to do so, though the thought of singing in front of Lady Sirenmon makes ShogunGekomon extremely nervous. He says he could probably do a passable showing, but thinks his bandmates aren't spirited enough. He sends out Yuki to find some Spirit Seeds, refusing to sing for Sirenmon without them. Yuki travels around the Forest and collects three of them, then gives them to ShogunGekomon — who then has his bandmates eat them. Now full of spirit, they go to Sirenmon and sing for her. She enjoys it so much, her sprout grows a Karpos Hulē. She allows Yuki to take it as thanks for bringing the singers to her. The Pinnacle of the Card World The Card King messages Yuki , saying it was time to determine who the true Card King was. He says to go to the Electric Town South Exit, in which Yuki duels and defeats him. Shocked, the Card King reveals he was actually Leopardmon and passes his title of King on the Yuki. He says he plans to remain there for a while so he can continue playing, and will go to the rendezvous point before the final battle. Yuki receives a message from an unknown sender, who praises them for their win and says they've earned the right to duel them. Yuki goes to Shinjuku as instructed, and learns the mystery sender was the one who had given them their first cards eight years before. He says he is the true Card King, and challenges Yuki to determine who the real true Card King is. Yuki defeats him as well, and becomes the new true Card King. A Stubborn Fighter? Gankoomon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he's bored as he had been waiting for Jesmon — who hadn't shown up despite having agreed to meet at the Paradise Colosseum. Yuki visits him, and he asks Yuki to tell Jesmon he's waiting if they find him — saying Jesmon had gone off to try ramen. Yuki is able to find Jesmon and send him to Gankoomon Yaro-Kei Ramen , with Gankoomon thanking them — not just for finding Jesmon, but for telling them where the rendezvous point was. Gankoomon says Yuki deserves a reward...with the reward being a fight against Gankoomon. He also tells Jesmon to fight alongside Yuki, as he wants to see if Jesmon got rusty. They defeat him, and Jesmon suggests for the two of them to go to the rendezvous point. Gankoomon laughs, and says he actually could've gone there at any point and hadn't because Alphamon had told him to stop acting as a Royal Knight. This confuses Jesmon, and when he asks why Alphamon said that — even Gankoomon had no clue. He says Alphamon had been talking about how he thought the human race didn't deserve to live, and he didn't know whether he should listen to Alphamon or King Drasil . He says he'll make his choice later, and asks Yuki and Jesmon to be there when he does. Yaro-Kei Ramen Jesmon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he keeps getting the wrong Yaro-Kei Ramen order. Yuki visits him, and notices he looks awful. He says he's hungry and is close to dying, and explains again about how he keeps getting the wrong order. He says his master must be furious as he's late, and becomes shocked when Yuki says they know Gankoomon . Yuki explains how neither he nor Jesmon had gone to the rendezvous point, and he says he'll go there after he eats the correct ramen. He asks Yuki if they know how to order it, and they teach him how to do so. Jesmon is finally able to order and eat the ramen, and gives Yuki a reward as thanks. He then leaves to meet up with Gankoomon. Choosing a Human Representative! Gankoomon messages Yuki asking for help, as his friend is in a real fix. Yuki goes to Akihabara and meets up with both him and Jesmon , with the two of them being in front of an Outer Dunegon. Gankoomon says his human friend is inside, and that he wants to check on him. He says he'll make his choice of how to side with based on how it goes, either with Alphamon — who was assessing the humans, or King Drasil — who wants to protect the humans. He took Jesmon and Yuki with him as they can act as witnesses representing the Digimon and Human sides. Once inside, Jesmon and Yuki learn it's a bar — whilst Gankoomon finds his friend flirting with a LadyDevimon waitress. She tells him to pay for his bill, though he isn't able to afford it and asks Gankoomon for money. Gankoomon is surprised his friend has no money as he won him a lot in the arena, and his friend says he already spent all that money in this bar. He says he'd messed up as the money was for his family, and asks Gankoomon to fix a fight in the arena so they can make lots of money together. Gankoomon says he's made his choice, and Jesmon begs him to reconsinder saying not all humans are are bad as him and that Yuki is a good human. He correct Jesmon and says he's chosen to protect humanity, and that it'd be more fun to train weak humans like this one instead of destroying them. Wanting to help his friend, Gankoomon says he'll destroy the bar — causing LadyDevimon to ask Kuzuhamon for help. They beat it up and leave the bar, with the human seemingly not paying his bill. Gankoomon asks if he's learned his lesson, and he says yes — though he also asks to borrow money to get the train home. Gankoomon agrees, though says he'll show up at his house when his family is home if he doesn't pay it back. After the man leaves, Gankoomon says he doesn't actually expect to get the money back but has still decided to side with humans. Gankoomon notes how much Jesmon had grown during the fight with Kuzuhamon, and says it's time for them to go to the rendezvous point. Blink and You'll Miss It Asuna Shiroki messages Yuki , asking for help as she and Monica Simmons had encountered an unidentified flying object in Akihabara . Yuki meets up with them, with Monica saying it might be a Digimon and Asuna saying that capturing it will be hard as it's so fast — which is why she called in Yuki. Moncia says it seems to be following a defined path, and that she's narrowed down multiple points they could intercept it meaning they'll need to split up. She says the most likely spots were the ramen shop and the Sorayodo model shop, and has Asuna go to the model store whilst she and Yuki go to the ramen shop (as she had already gone to the model store that day and wanted Asuna to learn how amazing it was). They wait a long time, but it doesn't show up. Yuki gets bored and demands ramen, whilst Monica decides to call Asuna over to the ramen store. Asuna says she had bought a large amount of action figures, as she had ended up falling to the store's allure like Monica had wanted. Kentaurosmon crashes into them whilst they were distracted, and they realise he was the unidentified object. Kentaurosmon meanwhile is angry at them for getting in the way of his restaurant tour. They fight, with Kentaurosmon impressed at them being able to defeat a Royal Knight. He assumes they're friends of King Drasil 's due to their strength, with him mentioning his boss causing him to realise he was meant to be doing something else. He asks them where he was meant to go, and luckily for him — Yuki was indeed friends with King Drasil. Yuki tells him to go to the rendezvous point, and he remembers he already knew where that was. He gives them a reward and leaves, with Monica sad his tour was over and she wanted to suggest somewhere. Asuna then leaves, saying she needs to pick up her action figures. The Beautiful Knight Corps Dynasmon messages Yuki , saying that although he was at the rendezvous point — LordKnightmon wasn't, which he finds worrisome. Yuki goes to him, where he says LordKnightmon was meant to have arrived by now, and wonders if something had gone wrong in an investigation LordKnightmon was doing. He asks Yuki to go to Akihabara to find him, and Yuki finds him in front of an Outer Dungeon. LordKnightmon says his Knight Corps betrayed him and stopped following orders, and says he locked them inside the Dunegon. Kentaurosmon shows up and says he's not used to seeing LordKnightmon upset, and he agrees to help. Kentaurosmon says the Knights probably glitched because of the firewall in the human world, and that they're probably going to have to beat them up to bring them back to their senses. LordKnightmon had hope it wouldn't come to that, but ends up agreeing to fight them. The three of them go into the Dungeon, and kill them all. With that dealt with, LordKnightmon goes to the rendezvous point. A Display of Beautiful Swordplay Kentaurosmon messages Yuki , saying Dynasmon and LordKnightmon were arguing and it was annoying him. Yuki goes to them, and sees what they're arguing about. Dynasmon says LordKnightmon has no confidence in his swordsmanship, which is why he has his own army. LordKnightmon disagrees with this, and says he has the Knight Corps because it enhances his beauty. Dynasmon says Crusadermon had actually fallen behind his own minions in the way of the sword, that that was pathetic, and that he would've lost to his own minions had he and Yuki not been there. LordKnightmon says he will prove his strength by fighting Grademon, who is a renowned knight. LordKnightmon asks Yuki to go find Grademon, and Dynasmon tells them in secret that Grademon is at the Paradise Colosseum. Yuki tells LordKnightmon where Grademon is, and he leaves to go fight him. Dynasmon asks Yuki if he went too far, and Yuki says he did. He says he thought he hadand says he just wanted him to stop being so reckless. He sends Yuki after him, where Yuki finds Grademon having turned down a fight. Grademon says he has no reason to point his sword at him, and that he cannot fight a Royal Knight. Yuki says they have actually defeated Grademon before, and having heard this, LordKnightmon challenges them as defeating Yuki would mean he's also stronger than Grademon. Yuko defeats him, which upsets LordKnightmon — though he notes that Yuki is strong as they've defeated Grademon before. This being the case, it wasn't clear who was the stronger between them — leading him to ask Yuki who was stronger. Regardless of answer, LordKnightmon says he's satisfied and will return to the rendezvous point and make peace with Dynasmon. Alpha and Omega Agumon messages Yuki , saying to come to Central Tower so he can show all the Royal Knights that were there. Once Yuki arrives, Agumon celebrates at the fact that twelve of them (including himself and Gabumon as Omnimon ) had gathered. They say may be able to save the World now, but Alphamon suddenly appears and says that he is not quite sure of that just yet. They're surprised to see Alphamon showing up, since he's the empty seat, and Alphamon says he is going to test Yuki's virtue as there's nothing worse than a flawed sense of justice. He finds humans disgusting, as they justify their cruel experiments on Digimon as research — but is aware there are some humans that reject that notion. As such, he wants to see if those specific humans deserve his trust. Agumon and Gabumon try to talk him out of it by saying there's good humans, but Alphamon refuses to back down and says that's what he's here to determine. Agumon and Gabumon become Omnimon and join Yuki's side, and Alphamon is fine with this — saying to prove their faith in humans to him. They defeat him, and he acknowledges the strong bond between humans and Digimon as well as the potential of humans. He agrees to a ceasefire, and says he will observe things quietly from here on — but also warns he will take action if the humans stray. He praises Omnimon for his stregnth, and says he managed to prove humanity's potential. An Odd Letter Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , asking for advice as she got an odd letter. Once Yuki arrives, Hiroko shows the letter is from Kosuke Misono , and that it may be a faker since it's weird he would send a letter to his own office. She says there was a key inside for a coin locker in Shinuku Station, but was too scared to open it on her own. Once they open it, they find a machine part — and Hiroko is certain she's seen something like this before. She thinks back, and thinks she remembers seeing it at the site of the big disaster and that Kosuke appears to have stolen and hidden it since then. They travel to the site, where an Outer Dungeon suddenly appears. It sucks them in, where they're confronted by Machinedramon — who had finally located its missing part. The Royal Knights show up, saying they had sensed an immense power — and offer to help. There was only enough space for one of them though, so Yuki chooses one to aid in the fight. They defeat Machinedramon, who dies saying it'll return and will reborn as many times as needed. After the battle, Hiroko says it makes sense that Kosuke had looked into it since that's where his wife and son died — and wonders if he sent the part so that they could get revenge for him. Despite their current strained relationship, Hiroko says she still believes in Kosuke and rewards Yuki for the help. Royal Knights' Test Match Agumon messages Yuki , saying the Royal Knights had recovered most of their strength and to meet up with them. Yuki goes to them, where Agumon says they all want to fight Yuki. Yuki then fights them all in thirteen separate battles. Olympos XII's Test Match A Minervamon from an alternate world messages Yuki , saying she wants to talk to them in Akihabara . Yuki finds her in front of an Outer Dungeon, where she says she and the rest of the alternate world Olympos XII want to fight Yuki. Yuki goes inside and fights all of them at the same time.

games.title: Elden Ring
games.description: An open-world action RPG by FromSoftware. This 24-step guide walks you through the entire critical path, from the Chapel of Anticipation to the final boss — without missing major content.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content_html:
The following is a Walkthrough guide to Elden Ring.

The goal of this Walkthrough is to position the player in a way that they are able to complete the game without missing any content. It will not dictate equipment or quest choices, only highlight the options. It will also not specifically mention every item or other minor details.

The goal of this Walkthrough is to position the player in a way that they are able to complete the game without missing any content. It will not dictate equipment or quest choices, only highlight the options. It will also not specifically mention every item or other minor details.

sections.title: Step 1: Chapel of Anticipation
sections.content_html:
Select whatever starting class and item you want. For more character statistics details, see Stats and Attributes.

Exit the chapel and head downstairs to the open plaza with a large statue. You will be attacked by a Grafted Scion. You likely can't beat this boss yet and even if you do, you will just fall off a cliff shortly thereafter.

sections.title: Step 2: Limgrave
sections.content_html:
You wake up in the Stranded Graveyard. The game automatically hands you the flasks for HP and FP restoration.

In front of the spirit on a chair is a cave that you can jump down to. That's the tutorial area. Once you complete it, you will end up back at the spirit on the chair. Now head upstairs and ascend with the elevator, then go outside.

You'll be greeted by White-Faced Varré. You can talk to him for some exposition or just ignore him. Activate the Site of Grace, then sneak past the Tree Sentinel knight uphill to the Church of Elleh, where you will find the merchant Kalé and another grace. If you can, buy the crafting kit from Kalé.

Next travel through the forest to the north-west. You'll arrive at a soldier camp. Clear it or skip it, then pick up the Limgrave Map at the street and activate the nearby Gatefront Ruins grace. Melina will show up. Simply accept her accord, you can't beat the game without it anyway. Melina will give you the Spectral Steed Whistle for Torrent.

Use Torrent to travel south-east along the road up until you hear an npc speak. That npc is Boc and he is camouflaged as a bush. Attack or roll into the bush and talk to Boc. He'll tell you about a cave at the shore south-west of the church where you met Kale. We'll go there soon.

For now we want to go further east, across the bridge that is going to be occupied by a Night's Cavalry. Either wait until morning at a grace or sneak past it, because it is unlikely that you can defeat it yet.

Follow the road down up until you see a bunch of ruins on a hill to the north-east. Make your way past the giant plants and down into the cellar, where there is a Mad Pumpkin Head miniboss. Defeat it and activate the grace. In the room at the end of the cellar is Sellen. You can buy some sorcery Spells from her should you need any, but it is preferable to spend your Runes on leveling up.

Proceed further down the road to the southern end of the lake. There will be the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace at the foot of the hill, not far from where there is a Teardrop Scarab with the Ash of War: Unsheathe in the lake. Travel west to the large ruin. Beneath it is Bloody Finger Hunter Yura. Relevant for casters: east of the Agheel Lake site of grace is an enemy camp with the Royal House Scroll.

Yura will warn you of a dragon in the lake. We will cross the lake regardless, but avoid the dragon for now by sticking to the cliff on the west end of the lake. Travel all the way north-west in the lake to the mining cave. Skip the crab enemies, none of them are worth fighting.

Clear the entire mining cave. The yellow stones on the walls are free Smithing Stones, pick them up. At the end of the cave is a Stonedigger Troll miniboss. Defeat it.

Now warp back to the Church of Elleh and use the anvil there to upgrade your weapon to +3. Should you have missed some Smithing Stone 1s in the cave, you can buy a few more from the merchant at the shore south-west. Buy the crafting kit if you haven't already. Use any remaining Runes to level up.

Now travel to the north-west. There is a dungeon inside of the cliff with a watchdog miniboss at the end. Clear it and use the runes to level up.

Next go down to the shore mentioned earlier and visit Boc in the Demi-human cave, not far from where the merchant is. Talk to Boc, then defeat the miniboss in the cave to reclaim his sewing needle and give it to him. You can also proceed past the miniboss arena to the small island in the south, where there is a grace in front of the Church of Dragon Communication.

Relevant for melee users: it is now worth picking up Armorer's Cookbook 1 from a small enemy camp north-east of the Gatefront Ruins, west of the bridge. It can be used to craft Fire Grease.

Warp to the Waypoint Ruins with Sellen, but now travel north instead of south and follow the road to the north-east. There will be the Mistwood Outskirts grace on the right-hand side. On top of another large ruin similar to the one you found Yura beneath will be Kenneth Haight. Talk to him, then follow the road again until you reach the Third Church of Marika. Here you'll find your Flask of Wondrous Physick and a Sacred Tear to upgrade your regular flasks at the grace. Melina will also offer some lore when talked to at the grace here.

Follow the path again up until you see the Minor Erdtree. Kill the Teardrop Scarab on the way up for the Ash of War: Ground Slam and pick up the Crystal Tears from a bowl behind the Minor Erdtree. Then return to the path and keep riding south until you reach Fort Haight. Activate the grace at the foot of the hill called Fort Haight West, then clear the entire fort. Relevant for melee users: you'll find the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook 6 here, which lets you craft Blood Grease. Fort Haight is also a good spot to farm Blood Roses for it. Once you have beaten the knight that drops Ash of War: Bloody Slash and picked up one half of the Dectus Medallion from the tower, return to Kenneth Haight and report your victory.

Return to Church of Elleh and talk to Kalé. He'll tell you about Blaidd and give you the Fingersnap Gesture. Return to the Mistwood Ruins and use it there, at the ruin with the large Runebear inside. Talk to Blaidd, then warp to the Agheel Lake South grace. Travel uphill to the Forlorn Hound Evergaol and defeat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil. You can summon Blaidd here if you so choose.

Level up again and travel all the way north through the lake, to the river beneath the bridge where the Night's Cavalry patrols. You will be invaded by an NPC here and Yura will come to your aid. Defeat the invader, then go all the way north to find Yura beneath the rock formation. Talk to him there, then go back south a little and enter the Murkwater Cave in the cliff to the east. Here you'll find Patches.

Now warp back to the Gatefront Ruins.

sections.title: Step 3: Stormhill
sections.content_html:
Follow the path to the north-west up until you arrive at the Stormhill Shack. Pick up the Golden Seed, unlock the grace and upgrade your flask. Then talk to Roderika in the Shack. Now travel all the way east to the Warmaster's Shack. Here you'll meet Bernahl. You can also farm infinite Root Resin here for Blood/Fire Grease.

Continue further east until you can climb uphill to the Deathtouched Catacombs. You'll meet Iron Fist Alexander on the way there. Clear the catacombs, return to the road and travel further east to Summonwater Village. You'll meet D (NPC) on the way. Defeat the Tibia Mariner and talk to D in the village. You can pick up the Green Turtle Talisman here from an underground room. Level up, then warp to the Third Church of Marika and use the hidden gateway portal north of it in the lake. D should have made a marker for it on your map. It will warp you all the way to Caelid. Don't bother with the Black Blade Kindred, it will oneshot you since you are severely underleveled for this area. Simply enter the Bestial Sanctum and talk to the Beast Clergyman. If you so choose, you can also travel south from here to pick up another Golden Seed and farm the Vulgar Militia enemies for Runes, they are relatively weak and drop around 1000 each. This is the best spot for Rune farming early game.

Warp back to the Stormveil Shack in Limgrave, then follow the road north. Kill the Teardrop Scarab for Ash of War: Wild Strikes on the way. Run past the enemies, unlock the Castleward Tunnel grace and talk to Melina. You can attempt to fight the boss here, but are unlikely to be able to defeat it yet unless you farmed the Vulgar Militia enemies.

First warp back to the Warmaster's Shack and ride up the hill to the north, then all the way to the cliff in the east to pick up the Lance Talisman. It will help you a lot when fighting large enemies on horseback. Now return to the Agheel Lake grace and defeat the Flying Dragon Agheel.

Afterwards, level up and travel south from the lake through the ravine and over the bridge.
sections.content_text: Follow the path to the north-west up until you arrive at the Stormhill Shack. Pick up the Golden Seed , unlock the grace and upgrade your flask. Then talk to Roderika in the Shack. Now travel all the way east to the Warmaster's Shack . Here you'll meet Bernahl . You can also farm infinite Root Resin here for Blood/Fire Grease. Continue further east until you can climb uphill to the Deathtouched Catacombs . You'll meet Iron Fist Alexander on the way there. Clear the catacombs, return to the road and travel further east to Summonwater Village . You'll meet D (NPC) on the way. Defeat the Tibia Mariner and talk to D in the village. Afterwards, level up and travel south from the lake through the ravine and over the bridge.

sections.title: Step 4: Weeping Peninsula
sections.content_html:
Run past the enemies on the Bridge of Sacrifice, then unlock the grace with the same name to your right. A little further south beneath a bridge is Irina. Talk to her and accept her request to deliver a letter to her father, Edgar. Continue further south until you find a merchant next to the Castle Morne Rampart grace. Head a little further south to where a giant will shoot arrows at you. Don't approach him yet, simply pick up the Golden Seed on the hill and travel back to the north-west until you arrive at the South of the Lookout Tower grace. Ride west through the Demi-human Forest until you cross a bridge, then travel north to the Church of Pilgrimage. Pick up another Sacred Tear for your flask, then ride south to the Minor Erdtree and defeat the Erdtree Avatar there.

Afterwards, keep traveling south-west until you see the Walking Mausoleum. Ride towards it and then uphill to the west until you arrive at the Fourth Church of Marika. You can talk to Melina again here and pick up another Sacred Tear. Near the church to the north is an Evergaol miniboss and a poison filled cave. Clear them if you want, otherwise just travel south past the Witchbane Ruins until you arrive at the Isolated Merchant's Shack. The merchant here sells a couple relevant items, most notably the Lantern. If you are short on runes, simply warp to Caelid, kill two Vulgar Militiamen and warp back.

Now warp to the Castle Morne Rampart grace with the merchant again and ride south towards the giant that fired arrows at you earlier. Defeat him and continue into Castle Morne. Activate the grace, then go up the elevator. You can pick up some items here or just run past all the enemies to the ladder in the back. Explore the area until you find Edgar. Give him Irina's letter, then explore the southern end of the Castle, unlock the grace there and jump down several platforms until you arrive at the shore and activate the grace here as well.

At the shore is a boss fog with the Leonine Misbegotten. The key to defeating this enemy is figuring out how you can stun it, since it will be attacking non-stop otherwise and hits relatively hard. For most melee weapons, that means having to wait for an opening to use heavy attacks. It drops the Grafted Blade Greatsword when defeated, which is the legendary weapon that Edgar was talking about. Report back to Edgar and visit Irina at the Bridge of Sacrifice.

Clear up the remaining optional bosses. Return to Limgrave and defeat the Tree Sentinel, then also the Night's Cavalry on the bridge, as well as the Night's Cavalry near the merchant in the central Weeping Peninsula.

sections.title: Step 5: Stormveil Castle
sections.content_html:
Spend all your remaining Runes to buy Margit's Shackle from Patches (or just farm Militiamen for it), then warp to the Castleward Tunnel grace. It is time to fight Margit the Fell Omen.

Regardless of whether or not you beat Margit on your first try, Melina will now warp you to the Roundtable Hold the next time you sit at a grace, if she hasn't done so already. Speak to every npc there, but don't hold on to Fia's Baldachin's Blessing. Now wait until night-time and warp to the Church of Elleh, where you will meet Lunar Princess Ranni. She gives you the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.

If you still can't seem to defeat Margit, you can skip ahead to Step 6 and return to Stormveil Castle a little later.

After defeating Margit, you will arrive at the Stormveil Main Gate and meet Gostoc the Gatekeeper. Have him open the main gate for you, then proceed past the hole in the wall next to Gostoc regardless. You can backtrack at specific points to confront Gostoc about stalking you. If you don't do this twice, he will keep stealing a portion of your dropped Runes every time you die within Stormveil Castle. Gostoc will also lock you in a room with a Banished Knight, where the Rusty Key is. After acquiring the Rusty Key, you can talk to Gostoc again at the main gate and buy items from him. If you enjoy Parrying enemies early game, it is highly recommended to buy the Buckler from him. Do not kill Gostoc.

Explore all of Stormveil Castle until you have met both Rogier and Nepheli Loux. There is going to be another Golden Seed not far from where you find Nepheli. You can also fight an optional Ulcerated Tree Spirit miniboss, as well as a Grafted Scion and a Crucible Knight in the castle. Once done with everything, it is time to fight Godrick the Grafted.

After defeating Godrick, pick up the Shabriri Grape from the room beneath the Stormveil Castle throne room and exit the castle to the north.

sections.title: Step 6: Liurnia of the Lakes
sections.content_html:
Touch the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace and talk to both Hyetta and Boc there. Give Hyetta the Shabriri Grape you just picked up. Then meet Thops in the Church of Irith. Travel down into the lake and touch the Liurnia Lake Shore grace next to the merchant. He sells more Smithing Stones, should you need any.

Immediately north-west of the merchant is the Malefactor's Evergaol that you can jump up to with a Spiritspring Jump on horseback from the lake. Defeat Adan Thief of Fire and travel further north into the lake. Touch the Laskyar Ruins grace and rest, then travel straight east to the Purified Ruins where Hyetta is standing at the shore. You probably don't have another Shabriri Grape for her yet, so just travel north-east from there and touch the Liurnia Highway North grace. You can travel south-east from here to the Cliffbottom Catacombs, but it is not important.

First go back into the lake and travel north from the Laskyar Ruins to where you can pick up them map. You can find Rya nearby at a pavilion. Accept her request to retrieve her necklace, then travel west to the Scenic Isle, where you'll run into Patches again. He isn't the guy who stole her necklace however. Travel directly north from where you met Patches to the Boilprawn Shack where Blackguard Big Boggart resides. He has her necklace, but won't give it to you unless you give him 1000 Runes. He has his own little quest, so killing him is not recommended. Rather just unlock the Boilprawn Shack grace and fast travel to the Dragonbarrow again to kill a Vulgar Militia, then buy it from him.

Ride north to the Academy Gate Town and unlock the grace there, then continue further north to meet Diallos Hoslow. Talk to him and ride far into the west until you arrive at either the Rose Church or the Temple Quarter. White-Faced Varré will be at the Rose Church and hand you some Festering Bloody Fingers for PvP invasions. You have to use them to continue his quest, although the only thing you get for doing it are PvP items and Varré's Bouquet very late into the game. If you have found enough Smithing Stone 2s to upgrade your weapons again, now is the time.

Ride further west from there and go back on land, then find the Revenger's Shack Site of Grace, south of the Cuckoo's Evergaol. Defeat Edgar, then bring his Shabriri Grape to Hyetta at the Purified Ruins. You can also pick up the third Shabriri Grape from the ruins further uphill.

Warp back to the Revenger's Shack and then travel south to the Minor Erdtree to defeat the Erdtree Avatar there and north to defeat Bols, Carian Knight at the Evergaol, in whatever order you want. Warp to the Boilprawn Shack and ride south-west to the poison-swamp part of the lake. Meet Nepheli Loux at the village and defeat the Omenkiller with or without her.

Level up and ride north-east from the Cuckoo's Evergaol. Defeat Glintstone Dragon Smarag and pick up the Academy Glintstone Key. Travel north-east from there and clear the Academy Crystal Cave, at the bottom of the cliff on the western side of the academy.

Then ride all the way around the academy to the north-eastern end of the lake, directly east of the large broken bridge, and enter the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. Clear the dungeon for the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1] and a bunch of different Smithing Stones along the way. Upgrade your weapons again, then warp to the Academy Gate Town and enter the academy from there.

sections.title: Step 7: Academy of Raya Lucaria
sections.content_html:
Touch the grace, then run past the seal to the north out onto the bridge. You'll find a red summon sign for Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's quest. Complete the invasion and talk to Yura at the bridge.

Past the seal to the south is merchant hidden among the trees and even further down the path a Celestial Dew guarded by a Bloodhound Knight.

Enter the elevator next to the grace and fight your way through the academy. Once near the boss fog, use Margit's Shackle to remove illusory walls and pick up some hidden items. Defeat the Red Wolf of Radagon and level up again.

Go outside to where the Abductor Virgin patrols a plaza, but run upstairs and jump down a railing onto another set of stairs. Kill the mages, go downstairs and open the door for a shortcut, then go upstairs again and jump down onto the rooftops. Descend from there until you reach the Church of the Cuckoo. Enter the building through a window and position yourself on the wooden beams to jump down onto the chandelier that holds an item. It's the second Academy Glintstone Key for Thops. Then jump over to the upper level and kick down the ladder for a shortcut. Go outside from the upper level and descend from there to kill a crystal crab, which drops the Twinsage Glintstone Crown.

Now return to the Debate Parlor where you fought the Red Wolf and run across the plaza to the rafters. Jump over to the bridge and dodge the giant rolling globes. Defeat Moongrum, Carian Knight and head to the east to unlock a shortcut by opening a door. Then take the gateway portal to the Church of Vows and touch the grace there. Return to the Debate Parlor again and make your way to the elevator where you defeated Moongrum and ascend to the Grand Library, where you have to fight and defeat Queen Rennala.

Warp back to the Church where you met Thops and give him the Glintstone Key, then warp to the Academy's Schoolhouse Classroom grace and check on him outside of the building (he is dead).

sections.title: Step 8: Caria Manor
sections.content_html:
Warp to the Main Academy Gate grace and exit through the northern seal. Touch the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace and talk to Melina and Boc.

Visit the Roundtable and talk to everyone again. Finger Reader Enia will give you your third Talisman Pouch. Fia will have new dialogue if you let her hold you. Get the note from her on where to find the Black Knifeprint and travel to the Church of Vows. Ride north through the Uld Palace Ruins and up to the Minor Erdtree. Defeat the Erdtree Avatar there, then jump down to the north-east from there to continue further north and enter the Black Knife Catacombs. There will be a Black Knife Assassin miniboss hidden behind an illusory wall that you can dispel with Margit's Shackle as usual. You can summon D (NPC) for this boss.

Afterwards, give the knifeprint to Rogier and warp to the Revenger's Shack in west-Liurnia again. Now travel north to the Four Belfries, touch the grace at the top of the mountain, then warp back down again and continue further north to the Kingsrealm Ruins. Use Margit's Shackle again to dispel another illusory wall to the north. Unlock the Road to the Manor grace and talk to War Counselor Iji. Mention that Blaidd sent you.

Ride north to the manor and dodge the sorcery rain. Touch the Main Caria Manor Gate grace and prepare Fire Pots or Fire Grease. Enter the manor and kill the Fingercreepers with fire. Loot the whole place and touch the Manor Lower Level grace. There is a branching path here, one leads deeper into the manor, the other lets you jump down onto a rooftop and pick up the Sword of Night and Flame.

Move on to the Manor Upper Level, pick up the Golden Seed, defeat the Troll Knight for the Troll Knight's Sword. You can exit to the left before the boss room and jump down several levels at the graveyard with pot enemies to pick up more items.

Defeat the area boss, Royal Knight Loretta. Before moving on, warp back to the Roundtable and hear the news from Rogier about the Knifeprint. Then return to the manor and continue to the Three Sisters. Fight the Glintstone Dragon Adula. It will run away once dropping to 50%. Enter Ranni's Rise and confront her about the Night of the Black Knives. She tells you to get lost, so return to Rogier, hear his proposition, then return to Ranni again and become one of her vassals. Speak with War Counselor Iji, Blaidd and Seluvis in Ranni's Rise, then talk to Ranni again. Ranni sends you and Blaidd on a mission to find the Fingerslayer Blade in Nokron.

sections.title: Step 9: Siofra River
sections.content_html:
Warp to the Mistwood Ruins in Limgrave where you first met Blaidd, then take the elevator in the building near the Minor Erdtree down to the Siofra River. Clear the area, touch the Siofra River Bank grace and jump up the ledge to the west to pick up the Armorer's Cookbook 6, which lets you craft Preserving Boluses. You can farm the Crystal Cave Moss for it at the Academy Crystal Cave in Liurnia of the Lakes.

You'll find Blaidd at the cliff north of the Hallowhorn Grounds. He'll tell you speak with Seluvis to get info on Nokron, Eternal City. Clear the rest of the area and light all the fireplaces to fight the Ancestor Spirit boss. You can also take a gateway portal on top of a ruin in the central-east side where all the archers are, which leads you to the Dragonkin Soldier boss.

Level up, warp back to Ranni's Rise and meet Seluvis. While at it, also check on Pidia, who you'll need to jump down to from the cliff not far from where you find Seluvis. Seluvis tells you to ask Sellen about Nokron. Sellen in turn says that you have to defeat General Radahn in Caelid to be able to reach Nokron. You may also take Seluvis's Potion from him. Do not give the potion to anyone just yet. Report back to Blaidd.

sections.title: Step 10: Caelid
sections.content_html:
Travel to the Summonwater Village in Limgrave and ride to the east. Touch the Smoldering Church grace and pick up the two cookbooks. Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater will invade you there.

Keep following the road, first to the east up until the Caelem Ruins and then south until the Caelid Waypoint Ruins. Skip the Decaying Ekzykes dragon fight for now and also avoid the Aeonia swamp. Naturally, you touch every grace you come across. Stay on the road until you pass the Sellia Gateway. There will be an NPC message and a shack guarded by a large dog. Sneak past the dog and talk to Gowry.

To complete Gowry's request, you need to defeat Commander O'Niel in the Aeonia swamp. Bring lots of Preserving Boluses, because you will have to fight a Millicent invader on the way there. When the invasion begins, you get automatically dismounted. Run back to the shore, cure the Scarlet Rot and fight her on land. You'll need lots of space to dodge her Waterfowl Dance attack.

Get the Unalloyed Gold Needle and bring it to Gowry. He'll take it and repair it. In the meantime, warp back to west-Caelid and travel all the way to the south-west to Fort Gael. Clear the fort and take the gateway portal to Redmane Castle. Activate the Redmane Castle Plaza grace and return to Gowry.

Now ride north from Gowry's Shack into Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Light all three fires, loot the place, defeat the Nox Swordstress and Nox Priestess duo miniboss, pick up the Golden Seed and exit the town to the north. Activate the Sellia Backstreets grace, ascent the mountain and meet Millicent at the Church of the Plague. Talk to her, give her the needle, rest, then talk to her again at the church and another time at Gowry's Shack. Now ride further north past all the dragons to Fort Faroth. Clear the fort and pick up the second half of the Dectus Medallion.

Now warp all the way back to Liurnia of the Lakes. If you haven't done it yet, bring Rya her necklace. Otherwise go straight to the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace and ride north. Stop by at the Bellum Church to talk to Hyetta again, then continue up the mountain to the north-east and clear out the Frenzied Flame Village for the Fingerprint Grape.

Move on to the Grand Lift of Dectus in the north of Liurnia and activate it. Follow the road to the Altus Highway Junction grace and activate it, then warp back to Redmane Castle and meet Blaidd and Iron Fist Alexander at the plaza. Talk to Finger Maiden Thorelina to receive the Polite Bow gesture. Then talk to Witch-Hunter Jerren to initiate the Radahn boss fight. Pick up all the items at the plaza, since some parts of it will be locked once you defeat Radahn.

You can summon infinite npc phantoms during the fight against Radahn, up to 5 at a time. If you summon Great Horned Tragoth, he gives you the Casual Greeting gesture. Defeat Radahn and talk to both Blaidd and Alexander. Activate the grace, level up and ride all the way to the north-east, alonside the shoreline. Inside the cliff are the War-Dead Catacombs. You can clear it now or later.

sections.title: Step 11: Altus Plateau
sections.content_html:
We're taking a detour to the Altus Plateau before finishing Ranni's mission. Talk to the Roundtable NPCs again. Take the dagger from Fia and give it to D. Warp to the Highway Junction grace. You'll meet Corhyn on the road right next to the Altus Plateau map. He is looking for Goldmask.

Jump off the road to the west and search for the Second Church of Marika. You'll find Bloody Finger Hunter Yura there again. Defeat the invader, Eleonora, and then continue north. Once you see a long bridge to the west, quickly go to the other side, touch the Bridge of Iniquity grace and then go back to the Altus Plateau and keep riding north until along the road you reach the Road of Iniquity Site of Grace. Goldmask is right above this road. Keep following the road to the north-east to the Windmill Village. Meet Goldmask on the bridge and defeat the Godskin Apostle at the village. Then return to Corhyn and let him know about Goldmask's location.

You can explore the central area down the broken bridge north of Corhyn, where there is a Minor Erdtree and the Wormface miniboss, but it's optional. Warp back to the Highway Junction grace and ride to the east up to the gigantic gate. Sneak past the Tree Sentinel duo and pick up the two Golden Seeds at the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace. Follow the road to the south-east, leading to the Minor Erdtree Church. Talk to Melina at the grace and pick up the items there. Jump down to the lake north-east of the church and enter the Sealed Tunnel. Use Margit's Shackle again to dispel the illusory walls and pick up the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]. Defeat the Onyx Lord at the end of the dungeon and activate the grace.

Warp back to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, travel north to pick up more Golden Seeds and prepare for your rematch against Margit, The Fell Omen at the Outer Wall Battleground. Defeat him and stop by at the Hermit Merchant's Shack to the north-east, then go back to the Battleground. Leave the city wall to the north-west and travel south along the path all the way to the Sainted Hero's Grave on a hill. It will be guarded by a Black Knife Assassin that drops the Black Knife. Clear the Sainted Hero's Grave or leave it for later. South of it is the Stormcaller Church with another Sacred Tear.

Now warp back to Liurnia of the Lakes and ride to the north-end of the lake. Touch the "The Ravine" and "Ruin-Strewn Precipice" Sites of Grace on the way, then take the elevator to the mining cave and clear it to reach the "Ravine-Veiled Village" grace. Fight your way past the harpies. Near the boss fog is a ladder that leads to a Giant Land Octopus that guards the Serpent-God's Curved Sword. If you didn't already summon Great Horned Tragoth against General Radahn, you can do so here for the "Casual Greeting" gesture. The boss is Magma Wyrm Makar. Defeat him and continue though the Ruin-Strewn Precipice until you arrive at the Altus Plateau again.

Touch the grace and walk up the mountain, where Ancient Dragon Lansseax will attack you. Hit him a few times until he flies away, then warp to the Sainted Hero's Grave, change the time of day to night-time at the grace and take the elevator back up. Ride uphill to the east, where Lansseax will attack you again, this time for real. Defeat the dragon.

sections.title: Step 12: Nokron, Eternal City
sections.content_html:
It is time to finish Ranni's quest. Upgrade everything as far as you can, then travel to the Fort Haight grace in Limgrave. There is now a huge crater with floating rocks that you can jump down on. It leads you to the upper level of the Siofra River. Fight your way further down and defeat the Mimic Tear miniboss. Ride over the bridge and stick to the western side of the cliff until you reach the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace. You can light all 6 fireplaces here on the upper level of the Siofra River to fight the Regal Ancestor Spirit, or skip it and jump down onto the Night's Sacred Ground rooftops from the cliff at the Ancestral Woods grace.

Climb all the way down through Nokron. You'll find the Black Whetblade near an altar inside of a building. There is also a Stonesword Key imp statue with the Mimic Tear Ashes in a treasure chest behind it. Summoning the Mimic Tear will make most bosses significantly less difficult, decide for yourself if you want to make use of it or not. Exit the building where you found the Whetblade and touch the Night's Sacred Ground grace. There is a large open space with a dozen Silver Tear enemies. Simply run past them and pick up the Fingerslayer Blade from the treasure chest at the end, then escape via the gateway portal.

sections.title: Step 13: Deeproot Depths
sections.content_html:
Talk to War Counselor Iji, then warp back to the Agheel lake grace in Limgrave and interact with the Evergaol where you fought Bloodhound Knight Darriwil. Blaidd is inside of it. Warp back to Iji and get an explanation from him. You can then return to Blaidd and free him or leave him locked up, doesn't make a difference. Also interact with Seluvis if you still want anything from him.

Warp to Ranni's Rise with the Fingerslayer Blade. She will give you the Carian Inverted Statue that you need to find the Cursemark. The next time you rest, Ranni is gone and both Pidia and Seluvis are dead.

Travel to the Carian Study Hall in the east of Liurnia of the Lakes, not far from the Church of Vows. First clear the place without using the Inverted Statue, then return to the entrance, use the statue and progress all the way to the other end. A Godskin Noble will attack you on your way to the Divine Tower of Liurnia. Defeat it, take the elevator up the tower and pick up Ranni's Cursemark of Death.

If you haven't already, check back on the Roundtable Hold NPCs now. Fia leaves the Roundtable Hold and both D (NPC) and Rogier are dead.

Warp back to the Ancestral Woods and ride north past the docile blue jellies. Touch the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs grace and fight your way past the Crucible Knights. Defeat the Valiant Gargoyle duo and give D's Twinned Armor to the unresponsive NPC in front of the boss arena. Then walk to the end of the Great Waterfall Basin and interact with the coffin, which will take you to the Deeproot Depths.

You can fight the Erdtree Avatar for the Staff of the Avatar or just jump over the large roots to the north, past the giant ants. You can also pick up the legendary incantation Elden Stars from a ledge here. Continue north-west along the edge of the waterfall to the "The Nameless Eternal City" grace. You can jump one level down and further north-west until you run into Crucible Knight Siluria. The fight is optional, but behind the miniboss is a treasure chest with the Crucible Knight armor set.

Jump all the way up the roots to the east until you arrive at the "Across the Roots" grace. Fight Fia's Champions and touch the Prince of Death's Throne grace. Let Fia hold you and give her Ranni's Cursemark. Rest at the grace, then enter Fia's dream and defeat Lichdragon Fortissax. Pick up the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince and rest again. D's brother will show up and Fia is dead. Rest again to get the Inseparable Sword and Twinned Armor.

sections.title: Step 14: Ainsel River
sections.content_html:
Warp back down to the "The Nameless Eternal City" grace and hop into the coffin elevator. Touch the first grace you come across and warp back to Ranni's Rise. Ride north to Renna's Rise and pick up the Snow Witch Robe from a treasure chest, then take the gateway portal. Pick up Miniature Ranni from a coffin and sit at the grace. Select the "Talk to Miniature Ranni" option repeatedly until Ranni starts talking back to you.

You can now clear the entire Ainsel River area. Either head straight to Nokstella, Eternal City, or take a detour and defeat the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella first for some runes and a sorcery Spell.

You can fight your way through Nokstella, Eternal City for a Golden Seed, some Larval Tears and Moon of Nokstella, or just follow the river to the north and take the elevator down. Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader. Ranni will award you with the Discarded Palace Key. Take another elevator down. You'll arrive at the Lake of Rot.

Stock up on Preserving Boluses by crafting them. You can fight the Dragonkin Soldier and Alabaster Lord for the Alabaster Lord's Sword and Dragonscale Blade, or just loot the place and move south to the Grand Cloister grace. Jump down the platforms from the Grand Cloister grace. There is an optional Tree Spirit boss in the river of rot. You can also just skip it and move to the end of the river, where there is a coffin in front of a waterfall. Hop into the coffin to progress to the area boss, Astel Naturalborn of the Void.

Touch the grace after defeating the boss and warp back to the Academy's Grand Library with Queen Rennala. Pick up the Dark Moon Ring and warp back to Astel's boss arena. Continue to the elevator, which takes you to the Moonlight Altar. Move uphill to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and defeat Glintstone Dragon Adula. Touch the grace in the cathedral.

You can then do some optional content: the fight against Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader that awards you the Mimic Tear-level Black Knife Tiche summon, the Ranni's Dark Moon turtle puzzle, and some optional dragon fights for Dragon Hearts and the Cerulean Amber Medallion +2.

To finish Ranni's quest, jump down into the hole at the Cathedral of Manus Celes and interact with Ranni's puppet body in front of the slain Two-Fingers.

sections.title: Step 15: Dragonbarrow
sections.content_html:
Warp to the Church of the Plague in Caelid and ride north uphill, until you find the Spiritspring Jump. Jump up on top of the giant white skull and loot the bodies there for some free Smithing Stone 7s.

Then continue north towards Fort Faroth again and kill the giant sleeping dragon, it will drop over 50,000 Runes. Note that you can accelerate the process by using a bleed weapon. You can also farm this dragon indefinitely by riding back to the grace just as it dies and rest before it drops the Dragon Heart. This gives you all the Runes, but not the Dragon Heart, causing the dragon to respawn. This is also an easy way to become overpowered early game on a second playthrough, since the dragon doesn't fight back and bleed deals so much damage to it.

Jump down the next Spiritspring Jump near the fort to the Minor Erdtree and defeat the Putrid Avatar.

Spend your runes to level up once again. You should be at minimum level 60 by now, probably over 70. Travel to the west and towards the Divine Tower. Climb up using Torrent's double jump and the ladders. Touch the grace, pick up Radahn's Great Rune, warp back to the grace and descend the tower via the platforming challenge. There is a shortcut that you can unlock by climbing up the ladder immediately after the first iron elevator. Defeat the Godskin Apostle at the bottom of the tower, pick up the Godslayer's Greatsword from the treasure chest behind it. Then use the teleporter to get sent back outside and continue further west until you find the Isolated Merchant that sells the Beast-Repellent Torch.

If you haven't used the elevator in the north at the bottom level in Siofra River yet, go and activate it. It requires a Stonesword Key, but sends you to the Dragonbarrow Area with the Knights of the Great Jar, from where you can get the Great-Jar's Arsenal talisman.

sections.title: Step 16: Mt. Gelmir
sections.content_html:
Warp to the Altus Plateau and explore the western area until you find the Lux Ruins. Nearby will be a Golden Seed and the "Erdtree-Gazing Hill" grace. Talk to Millicent at the grace and then with Rya in the Lux Ruins, if you haven't already spoken to Rya after taking the Grand Lift of Dectus way back in Step 11.

Rya will teleport you to the Volcano Manor. Talk to Tanith and accept her offer to join the manor, there is no reason not to. Get the Drawing-Room Key from her and open all the doors. Pick up all the items in the manor and then go upstairs to fight Inquisitor Ghiza to get Ghiza's Wheel.

If you are short on Smithing Stones, warp back outside to the Erdtree-Grazing Hill grace and ride north through the ravine until you come across some trolls and the Old Altus Tunnel in the left side of the cliff. Clear the Old Altus Tunnel for some Smithing Stone 5s and Somber Smithing Stones 4, 5 and 6. If you need Smithing Stone 6s instead, go up one level to the Bridge of Iniquity, north of the Second Church of Marika, and fight your way up Mt. Gelmir to defeat the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast. You can also follow the path after it to fight another Ulcerated Tree Spirit near the Road of Iniquity grace, not far from the Volcano Manor entrance.

Once you are ready, travel alongside the Seethewater River in the ravine further north-west of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill. You have to go all the way around Mt. Gelmir and the Volcano Manor to the north-west. Clear Fort Laiedd for the Prelate's Inferno Crozier and defeat the Magma Wyrm south of it. Talk to Iron Fist Alexander in the lava mass a little further south to get the Jar helmet. Keep on riding south until you arrive at the Hermit's Shack. Defeat the Demi-Human Queen miniboss and talk to Glintstone Sorcerer Azur for the Comet Azur sorcery.

We're taking a quick detour to do Sellen's quest. Meet her in the Waypoint Ruins and get the key to Lusat's seal. Then warp to the Church of the Plague in Caelid and travel north until you arrive at the graveyard where there is a Battlemage enemy. You can also fight the scarlet rot Crystalian trio at the end of the cave for the Crystal Torrent Spell.

Explore the Shaded Castle to find the Valkyrie's Prosthesis for Millicent, then defeat Elemer of the Briar. Warp to where you fought Magma Wyrm Makar and do Patches's Volcano Manor mission, which requires killing Great Horned Tragoth.

Go deeper into the manor, fight the Bloodhound Knight, touch the grace further downstairs in the chapel. Go outside and clear the area. Defeat the Godskin Noble. You can proceed to clear out the rest of the area, but do not touch the gateway portal.

Pick up all the items in the manor and then go upstairs to fight Inquisitor Ghiza to get Ghiza's Wheel . If you are short on Smithing Stones, warp back outside to the Erdtree-Grazing Hill grace and ride north through the ravine until you come across some trolls and the Old Altus Tunnel in the left side of the cliff. Clear the Old Altus Tunnel for some Smithing Stone 5s and Somber Smithing Stones 4, 5 and 6.
